articleTitle: Feasibility Study of Solar Thermal System Integration for Hot Water Usage in a Hotel Located in Shetland Island, Scotland
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper aims to present detailed integration of solar thermal system in a hotel located in the west of Yell Island, Shetland. This was to assist in the island's carbon management plan as it attempts to reduce its carbon emissions. The proposed renewable energy system is a solar thermal system to meet the demand for hot water in the hotel. Prior to selection of a solar thermal system, the feasibility study of other renewable sources was also considered. The solar thermal system is made up of 22 Promatop 1.5 Vertical solar collectors, as this was the maximum number available on the 60 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> roof space. The gross area of the collector surfaces is 33.55 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. With the known area of the collectors, Photovoltaic Geographical Information System (PVGIS) data for irradiance at the site was converted to useful energy and transferred to heat in a hot water tank. The efficiency of the collector was calculated from collector specifications and ambient temperature to be approximately 65%. The energy demand of the hotel was calculated using standard value. Based on the analysis it is seen that the proposed system will meet the hot water requirements fully on a summer day and approximately ¾ during an off-peak season of the winter day. Additionally, a 5 KW auxiliary boiler is required to offset the energy deficit in winter months.

articleTitle: Automating Machine Learning Model Development: An OperationalML Approach with PyCARET and Streamlit
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: OperationalML (Automatic Machine Learning) refers to tools and techniques that automate various machine-learning model development aspects, including data preparation, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter optimization, and evaluation. OperationalML can significantly reduce the time and expertise required for building high-quality machine- learning models while making the process more transparent and scalable. In this study, we present an implementation of OperationalML using two open-source libraries: PyCARET and Streamlit. Our work focuses on evaluating the performance and usability of our implementation across classification tasks from publicly available datasets. Results show that our OperationalML system outperforms manual approaches, especially in speed and ease of use. Additionally, we conduct sensitivity analysis to assess the effectiveness of each component within the system and offer insights into future improvements that could enhance the overall quality of the generated models. This work contributes to the growing body of literature on Machine learning in Production, serving as a valuable resource for practitioners, researchers, and educators who want to quickly develop effective predictive models without spending extensive time on training machine learning.

articleTitle: Power Loss Analysis and Validation of the SEPIC-Ćuk Combined Isolated DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In developing countries where majority of the population depends on petrol-and diesel-based vehicles, Electric Vehicles (EVs) will play a major role in carbon footprint reduction. One of the primary requirements for encouraging EVs is to increase the number of charging stations. However, the issue related to waiting time before charging often gets neglected. This work proposes a novel DC-DC conversion system that combines the Single Ended Primary Inductor Converter (SEPIC) and Ćuk topologies. The operation and design of the proposed topology has been provided and the calculation of the losses in the various components of the circuit has been detailed for the specifications considered. Hardware results for charging of one 48 V Li-ion battery has been presented to compare the overall loss for validation. The proposed topology is derived to charge one EV battery at the design output voltage level and to simultaneously charge two batteries at half the output voltage, and is specifically suited for low-voltage, low-power e-bikes and e-rickshaw battery charging. The system uses fewer switches, thus making the control simple. High switching frequency operation leads to reduction in size and weight.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of ON/OFF, PID and Model Predictive Control System in HVAC Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper discusses on the implementation and impacts of various controllers used in a Rooftop Packaged HVAC System for its constant and variable volume configurations. The main objective of the paper is to bring a comparison between the traditional controllers like ON/OFF and PID with Model Predictive Control System, and to establish its effectiveness over the others for both zone temperature and energy consumption reduction controls. A mathematical model of building using basic thermodynamic equations is built in MATLAB/Simulink, and the controllers are designed for different configurations of the Rooftop unit to study its behavior. From the simulation results, it is found that PID surpasses ON/OFF controller in terms of energy consumption, whereas Model Predictive Control System (MPC) outperforms the other two in both controller performance and energy consumption reduction.

articleTitle: Remote Monitoring and Control of IEEE 5 Bus System
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In the electrical transmission system, many unexpected or unwanted situations may arise that may damage the system. Hence, it is important to monitor them continuously in real time to take necessary actions immediately. This paper aims to develop a Remote monitoring system by which the important transmission line parameters such as Voltage, Current, Frequency, Power, Power Factor can be monitored remotely using a cloud platform and to develop a Remote-control system by which the monitored parameters can be controlled according to the user and situation, from remote places. The control is of two levels: Cloud level control and Edge level control. The developed system is tested on a laboratory scale - IEEE 5 bus model which is present at Power Systems lab of Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Coimbatore, India. The results presented indicate that the proposed system successfully works.

articleTitle: Real-Time Investigation of LoRaWAN Architecture by LoRa Communication Module and Ultrasonic Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In recent years, Internet-of-Things (IoT) has become the primary technology used in the majority of automation applications. The majority of IoT devices used in remote monitoring applications run on batteries, therefore finding technologies with a long range and low power consumption is essential to prolonging the application's life. At the moment, IoT applications are created using Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Zig-Bee; however, these technologies do not meet those criteria. LoRa (Long Range) is an alternative technology that satisfies this need. The aim of this study is to shed light on LoRa by describing its advantages and disadvantages. The thorough analysis of the literature also reveals that the majority of uses for ultrasonic sensors are Internet of Things (IoT)-based applications, such as proximity and level detection and Signal-to-Noise-Ratio (SNR) and Received-Signal-Strength-Indicator (RSSI) quality assessment of received radio signals. As a result, this study also describes how it is done for the sensor and how it is used in a real-time LoRa-based IoT architecture.

articleTitle: Estimation of Battery State of Charge Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Battery management systems plays an important role in electric vehicle to ensure the safety of the battery. It is important to ensure the accuracy of the battery state of charge (SOC) for the safe, reliable and efficient operation of the electric vehicle battery. This paper presents an investigation into the estimation of battery SOC using machine learning models, specifically LSTM, Bidirectional LSTM and Vector Autoregression (VAR), as well as a combined model of VAR and LSTM. In this study, historical battery SOC data is utilized to train and evaluate the performance of the individual LSTM, Bidirectional-LSTM, and VAR models. Additionally, a combined model of VAR and LSTM is proposed to leverage the strengths of both approaches. Root Mean Square error (RMSE) has been considered as a performance metrices for the comparison of the models. The results indicate the effectiveness of the LSTM, Bi-LSTM, and VAR models in accurately estimating battery SOC. The combined VAR and LSTM model shows further improvement in prediction accuracy. The findings highlight the potential of machine learning algorithms, particularly LSTM, Bi-LSTM, and VAR, in battery SOC estimation.

articleTitle: Estimation and Analysis of Heat Dissipation Capability of Dielectric Liquids Using Induction Time for Oil-Paper Insulation System
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Polarization current measurement is a popular technique for condition assessment of oil-paper insulation systems. However, it is also known to be influenced by the change in measurement temperature. Further, the dielectric liquids serve the specific purpose of heat dissipation in a power transformer. The deterioration of these liquids causes poor heat dissipation and may also lead to severe breakdown of a power transformer. A parameter, induction time estimated from transient temperature-influenced polarization current data, contains crucial information regarding the heat dissipation capability of transformer liquids. This paper presents a comparative analysis of the heat dissipation capability of two different dielectric fluids. The present study considers aged mineral oil and a mixture of old mineral oil and fresh ester in an 80:20 ratio. Along with the estimation and comparative analysis of heat dissipation capability, other dielectric properties such as relative humidity, breakdown strength and viscosity are also compared for the two dielectric liquids.

articleTitle: Crop-Chat: Pioneering Agricultural Paradigms
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: India holds a prominent position as the second-largest global producer of agricultural output. As of 2023, the agriculture sector and its allied industries contribute 20 percent to the country's Gross Domestic Product (GDP). Despite the advancements witnessed during the digital era, farmers face a myriad of formidable challenges that hinder their progress. The proposed research work provides an ingenious solution by seamlessly employing the capabilities of Natural Language Processing (NLP) to support audio input and effectively assist farmers in various aspects of farming and market dynamics. CropChat demonstrates an exceptional comprehension and generate human-like text across an extensive range of over 95 languages.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control of Voltage-Oriented Control Technique on Voltage Source Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper initially introduces the three-phase PWM voltage source rectifier by using a voltage-oriented control technique. Modeling and control of the voltage source rectifier are helpful to make the system stable with the support of a dual-loop control strategy, this strategy is performing the constant DC-link voltage, similarly controlling the active power. The active power main goal is to control DC-link voltage and reactive power put as zero other wise use the power factor improvement technique. Shows the results, Controlling of DC-link voltage, voltage and current are in phase. This paper proposes the active and reactive power flows between the electrical system and load. In this work is done through the voltage-oriented method by using MATLAB/Simulink.

Author Keywords: Space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) technique

articleTitle: The Application of Image Processing for Mask Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In recent years, highly contagious viruses are on the rise, making it easy for people to contract the virus from one another when exposed to it. Face masks are used to prevent cross contamination as part of an infection control strategy. Without having the mask on, this increases the chances of contracting the virus as those viruses are being transmitted through droplets and sprays in the air. Due to any inconsiderate individual that refuses to put the mask on in high-risk places like health facilities, this action can endanger the lives of their loved ones as well as people around them. Therefore, an automatic system that is able to determine if a person is wearing a mask or not is proposed. This system is completed in three different stages which are face detection, facial features detection and mask detection. The face detection is first implemented into the system to determine the location of faces in the image. Then, the facial features such as eyes, nose and lips are determined. In order to implement both approaches, the Viola-Jones algorithm along with the coding system called cascade object detector method is used to detect all individuals' faces as well as all features. Lastly, the system is able to detect if an individual is masked or unmasked by allowing the system to distinguish those facial features. If no facial features are found by the system, the individual will be categorized as masked and vice versa. Upon successful implementation, the system will be able to help reduce the spread of diseases by performing automatic mask detection in enclosed areas, especially in healthcare institutes.

articleTitle: Leak Machine Testing for a Blow-Molded Component Using Programmable Logic Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: A product must first undergo quality assurance in the highly competitive market of today. Leak testing is one of the most crucial steps when analyzing a product's quality, and thanks to automation and the Fourth Industrial Revolution, the process is now more dependable, accurate, efficient, and timesaving. The already existing leak testing methods are broadly classified as dry leak test and wet leak test, where dry leak test generally involves testing the components with high-pressure dry air, and the wet leak test involves testing the component with water or dyes. Most industrial leak testing machine uses an Ateq controller for the differential pressure method which is very costly. This idea is an enhanced combination of both dry and wet leak tests where the testing blow-molded component which is a fuel tank for TVS PREMIER will be tested using differential pressure change method and bubble leak test in the final stage of the process. The main idea of this work is to design a costeffective automation system to detect any leakage in a blow- molded component. Delta dvp28SVProgrammable Logic Controller (PLC), Delta HMI - DOP-B07S411Human Machine Interface (HMI), and pressure transducer are used for the approach. The testing has been done and the required experimental output has been verified.

articleTitle: Dual Polarized Dielectric Resonator Antenna for WIFI Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: A dual polarized (DP) dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) is proposed to resonate at 5.8 GHz for WIFI applications. To realize the DP operation, the dielectric resonator (DR) mounted on the bottom plan over a rectangular coupling slot was triggered by two differential microstrip feds were etched on the front plan. The microstrips were curved to obtain both the left-hand circular polarization (LHCP) and right-hand circular polarization (RHCP) simultaneously. Whilst, to increase the port isolation we used the slot. The antenna achieves a resonance frequency of 5.78 GHz for both the RHCP and LHCP of -13.02 dB. The antenna measures a compact dimension with width and length of 6mm and 5mm respectively. The antenna measures a length and width of 6 and 5 mm which makes it a potential candidate for WIFI applications.

articleTitle: State of Charge Estimation Using Deeplearning
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: State of charge (SOC) estimation is an intricate task due to its dependencies on various battery parameters, external factors, and applications. Current methods implemented for state of charge estimation are prone to error accumulation, affected by fluctuations in external factors, or have high model complexity making them computationally intensive. This paper presents a deep-learning based approach using a feed-forward neural network with optimized hyperparameter selection for the real-time state of charge estimation of a Li-ion battery using an inexpensive hardware setup. Input to the model is circuit and ambient parameters which include current, voltage, average current, average voltage, and ambient temperature measured using appropriate sensors. The performance of the trained model is tested for various temperature settings showing highly accurate state of charge estimation results with lower RMSE than traditional methods. The trained model deployed in hardware setup shows accurate and reliable results for predicting the batteryâ€™s state of charge.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of CFSR-DC-DC Converter for EV Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel current-fed series resonant converter (CFSRC) designed specifically for electric vehicle applications. The primary innovation of this converter lies in its ability to achieve Zero Voltage Switching (ZVS) for the semiconductor switches on the primary side. This is accomplished through precise coordination of voltage and current within the series resonant tank circuit. Notably, this inventive technique enables the switches to turn off seamlessly, eliminating the necessity for snubber circuits. As a result, both circulating currents and switching losses are significantly reduced, leading to a notable improvement in overall efficiency. The efficacy of the proposed converter is validated through extensive simulations conducted using MATLAB Simulink, which demonstrate enhanced performance and behavior across various parameters.

articleTitle: Identification of Human Movement Through a Novel Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This study aims to identify human movement activities using machine learning, focusing on a novel ensemble approach. The objectives are twofold: to apply a new machine learning method for activity recognition and to outperform recent approaches in accuracy. A standard dataset from Kaggle contained six activities: standing, sitting, lying, walking, walking downstairs, and walking upstairs. The study used an SVM and Logistic Regression ensemble alongside other standard classifiers. The proposed ensemble achieved an accuracy of 95.45% on the test data, surpassing other models. This research shows the potential of the ensemble approach for accurate human movement identification with potential uses in various domains.

articleTitle: Automatic Number Plate Recognition and QR Code Double Authentication System for a Carpark
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Parking is one of the most important elements in a transportation system in highly populated urban areas. Unattended vehicles have the chance of being stolen if there is no way to authenticate the driver of the vehicle. Given this, Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) systems are one of the ways to monitor and track vehicles based on the information of the number plate. This information, along with the information about the driver can be used to verify and authenticate if the driver of the vehicle is the actual owner. Quick Response (QR) codes can encode information by transforming alphanumeric data into a unique pattern of data points. Therefore, this study aims to design a double authentication system by integrating ANPR and QR code authentication sub-systems to create a double authentication system that improves the security and safety of vehicles at carparks by creating a double authentication system. The study shows results that are working.

articleTitle: Design of 37-Level Inverter with Reduced Switch Count for Low Total Harmonic Distortion
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Nowadays the multilevel inverter plays a curial role in the generation of quality output waveforms due to their high modularity. This research article presents a novel 37-level Multilevel Inverter (MLI) with reduced components for the generation of quality AC stepped output. The proposed MLI utilizes the five DC sources with four bidirectional and eight unidirectional IGBT switches for the generation of required output voltage levels. The presented 37-level MLI has several merits such as lower harmonics (THD), less power losses, low TSV, higher efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. Theoretical analysis is presented in detail and compared the 37-level MLI with the existing MLIs with merits. Finally, the 37-level MLI is simulated with the help of MATLAB Simulink, and results are validated with the dSPACE RIT1104 controller.

articleTitle: Facilitating Fingerprint-Based Door Automation System Using RFID and Bluetooth
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper focuses on the adoption of biometric and RFID security gadgets as innovative solutions for enhancing door lock systems. The traditional reliance on physical keys has proven vulnerable to security breaches, prompting the need for more robust measures. Biometric features such as Fingerprint, Voice and Bluetooth offer unparalleled security by leveraging unique biological characteristics for authentication. Additionally, integrating RFID technology enables convenient access control through assigned cards or tags, eliminating the need for physical keys or complex passwords. The combination of these cutting-edge solutions establishes a comprehensive security infrastructure, significantly reducing risks associated with conventional lock systems. This research highlights the benefits and applications of these technologies in various settings, emphasizing their role in creating a safer environment for individuals and organizations.

articleTitle: IoT-Oriented Gesture Automation with Mesh Detection Through OpenCV and Pyfirmata Protocol Using ResNet-Mediapipe
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a hybrid gesture automation model and an IoT control system tailored for practical use, enabling the conversion of hand movements into electrical signals for home appliance control. While devising our workflow, we enhance AI gesture-based automation with mesh detection through OpenCV for object detection and recognition on python and pyfirmata protocol. We seamlessly integrate it with the Pyfirmata protocol and Mediapipe to boost recognition speed and precision. Besides, we formulated an algorithm trained to access the loads with precise data from hand gestures. Our experiments validate that ResNet-Mediapipe effectively captures hand positions in diverse scenarios, even within confined spaces. Operating within a pre-trained environment, it attains real-time gesture recognition with exceptional accuracy, exceeding 98.5%, and a remarkable recognition speed of up to 45 fps, outperforming alternative gesture recognition. Our novel gesture-controlled IoT system is outfitted with essential hardware components, such as the AVR Atmega 328p Microcontroller, NodeMCU ESP8266 wifi-based module Microcontroller, 5v relay switch, and a range of IoT devices, all of which play pivotal roles in its operation. Our system not only achieves gesture recognition powered by ResNet-Mediapipe but alsoeffectively manages a multitude of IoT devices. It boasts the benefits of low power consumption, uncomplicated hardware needs, intuitive hand gesture control, and seamless integration into human-computer interaction scenarios with minimal delay.

articleTitle: PV Grid Tied EV Charging System Performance Enhancement Under Unbalanced and Distorted Grid Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this study, a three phase EV charging system is presented with photovoltaic (PV) rooftop system connected to a non-ideal weak grid which is often prone to experiencing distorted and uneven voltages. The widely used SRF-PLL is unable to filter out the harmonically polluted grid voltage which lead to poor power quality indices and inject non-sinuosidal currents into the grid. In this article, NMTOGI PLL is used to extract positive sequence component from the grid voltages, which yields balanced grid voltage components and produces stable unit vectors of equal magnitude. This harmonic mitigation is further complimented by using NMTOGI control algorithm for extraction of fundamental component of nonlinear load currents. The NMTOGI control algorithm is significantly simpler to design, requires no modifications and carries less computing load and produces accurate fundamental component of currents. The EV charging system response is analysed for various practical scenarios such as PV power intermittency, load variations, weak grid conditions. The EV charging system is robust to such dynamic conditions and is able to deliver power with no power quality deterioration.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Fuel Cell-Based Three-Phase Interleaved Boost Converter Using PI Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Fuel cell electric vehicles, often known as FCEVs, are electric vehicles that are powered by fuel cells. In this study, different types of fuel cells, including a 6-kW proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC), perform well and are modeled and analyzed to inform the design of an interleaved boost converter. Power generated by fuel cells is both eco-friendly and efficient. However, the output voltage cannot be kept constant because of variations in operating circumstances; a converter is required. When developing a boost converter for a high-power application, the most difficult task is figuring out how to manage the high current that is being input while still maintaining a high output voltage. An interleaved boost dc-dc converter is provided here for the purpose of increasing the voltage for high-power applications. Based on different types of fuel cells the interleaved boost converter voltage of 140V and its efficiency has increased by 94%. To verify the designs, MATLAB/Simulink was used.

articleTitle: Electric Motor Systems: Relative Study on Diverse Motors in the Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In the contemporary world, Electric Vehicles (EV) is the essential technology to reduce the carbon emission in the transport industry. It uses electricity to charge the batteries as an alternate of the fossils fuels such as diesel or petrol. In the EV, electric motor plays the significant role to convert the electrical energy to mechanical energyto run the EV. There are diverse varieties of electric motors that are used in the EV vehicles. The presented paper signifies the types of EV and examines the different types of motors. Moreover, it analyse the features and limitations of the electric motors. Correspondingly, several researches focused on the diverse techniques for the enhancement of the electric motors to improve the performance of the electric vehicles. The presented paper compiles diverse electric motor researches and analyse the efficiency of the four types of electric motors. Similarly, it depicts the features and limitations of the electric motors. Moreover, a recent trend in the enhancement of the electric motors is signified in the projected study. The projected study is intended to contribute in the researchers related to the enhancement of efficiency of the EV.

articleTitle: Safeguarding SMS: A Dynamic Duo Approach to Tackle Spam Using LDA and QDA
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In our daily lives, the usage of mobile phones is increasing day by day. This trend has become more advantageous for scammers, who use mobiles as an intermediary device for their scams on individuals. Among various types of scams, one common method is sending spam SMS messages to people. These messages often contain fake links and aim to acquire personal details such as credit card numbers, as well as promoting various products. To combat these spam SMS messages, a spam detector has been implemented. The detector employs classification models, specifically Linear Discriminant Analysis and Quadratic Discriminant Analysis. The Spam Collection dataset serves as the dataset for this project. The dataset has been modified for further processing. Additionally, various Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques, including tokenization, handling of stop words, applying regular expressions, and Porter stemming, have been applied to the dataset. The outcomes of these NLP techniques have been converted into a corpus, which is used for count vectorization.For the classification, both Linear Discriminant Analysis and Quadratic Discriminant Analysis models have been used. The accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, confusion matrix, and ROC curve have been estimated for both models. A comparison of the performance of these models has been made based on accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, confusion matrix, and the ROC curve.

articleTitle: Comparative Performance Analysis of BLDC Motor Using PID and Fuzzy Logic Controllers
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this article Brushless DC (BLDC) motor characteristics are analyzed by using Fuzzy Logic Controller (FLC) and compared with conventional Proportional Integral and Derivative (PID) controller. The BLDC motors are mostly used in Electric Vehicle (EV) and industrial drive applications. It needs strong control capabilities of speed and torque profiles to accelerate the vehicle. The major drawbacks of conventional PID controller are speed overshoots problem and it has longer settling time. The FLC has overcome the speed overshoots and settling time problems. The advantages of FLC than conventional PID controller includes easy to design, adaptable to the parameters variation, better error detection and correction over a wide range of speed operating conditions. This MATLAB R2019b/Simulink work is performed based on Field Oriented Control (FOC) technique of BLDC motor. The FLC performance evaluation is superior over the conventional PID controller and provides the better control performance of BLDC drive.

articleTitle: Image Enhancement Method for QR Code Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The demand for dependable and effective QR code identification systems are rising as QR codes become more common in various applications. Nevertheless, the process of QR code recognition frequently confronts various challenges, including irregular background fluctuations, insufficient illuminations, and distortions arising from improper image acquisition techniques. To overcome the abovementioned issues, image enhancement method has become an important process for enhancing the degraded images due to illumination. This work proposed the integration of histogram equalization algorithm and gamma correction algorithm in the image enhancement process. Then, the experimental findings are analyzed and compared with several image enhancement methods. The results obtained from the experimental analysis substantiate the superiority of the proposed method when compared to alternative approaches concerning peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM), Mean Squared Error (MSE), and Multi-Scale Structural Similarity Index Measure (MS-SSIM).

articleTitle: Realization of a Modified Interleaved Buck Converter for Charging of Electric Vehicle Batteries
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Electric motors are used in electric vehicles instead of petroleum products as the primary source of propulsion. The reduction of contamination caused by consuming petroleum products is the main objective of introducing electric automobiles. One of the challenges with electric vehicles is effectively charging the battery to extend the battery's life. When a standard step-down converter is used in an EV charger, the converter load voltage and current have ripple, which reduces the battery's operating time. This impact is countered by using a modified two-stage interleaved step down converter, which reduces ripple at the input and output while also reducing the voltage and current strains across MOSFET switches utilized in the converter. Utilizing MATLAB-SIMULINK, the redesigned two-stage interleaved converter is constructed and investigated. The converter's performance is also compared to that of a standard buck converter, and tests have shown that interleaving increases the longevity of an EV charger by reducing ripple. For the purpose of proving the concept and validating the simulation findings, a hardware model of the converter is constructed. Implementing a converter for electric vehicles with less ripple content and improved charging system efficiency is the ultimate goal of this research endeavour.

articleTitle: A Slice-Aware Network Embedding (SANE) Strategy for Network Service Requests in 6G
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: 6G networks are projected to provide more individualized end-to-end services and innovative cloud-edge applications than current 5G networks. Network slicing (NS) is required when embedding 6G mobile network resources and sharing them across devices with varying needs. Recent advancements in 6G NS have been propelled by Network Function Virtualization (NFV) and Software Defined Networking (SDN) technologies, which virtualize network functions. Allocating resources in 6G is a pressing issue that needs additional study. Virtual network embedding focuses primarily on node mapping and link mapping, the two most important network properties. Resource allocation in a 6G network is addressed here by using the Slice-Aware Network Embedding (SANE) technique. The slice-defined node ranking method is shown for node mapping, and the k-shortest route algorithm is presented for link mapping, both of which are contributed to by this work. The performance of the proposed strategy is measured by looking at metrics like average acceptance rates, cost-to-revenue, and bandwidth utilization. The results of this study are compared to those of other researches done in the same area to demonstrate their validity.

articleTitle: A Novel Intruder Alert System Using LoRa and FMCW Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Intruder detection and alert systems are an essen- tial component for both residential and commercial premises. Most surveillance systems in remote locations depend on the availability of the internet on-site to transmit alert signals. This paper presents a novel experimental intruder alert system that doesn't use the internet on-site for the alarm mechanism. using an FMCW Radar and other peripherals such as camera, RaspberryPi and LoRa. The system leverages the long-range and low power consumption capabilities of LoRaWAN to transmit signals, while the FMCW radar and camera work together to detect and track intruders. To further enhance the accuracy of the system, the Yolov4 model is used for detection. Overall, this system has potential to significantly enhance security measures in remote locations.

articleTitle: Modelling a Wireless Power Transfer System for LD Electric Vehicles Using a Self-Oscillating ZVS Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Charging of EVs is of significant importance because of the complex power –electronics, batteries, motor and other electronics involved. EVs have short range due to the limitations of battery technology also; the charging process is very slow as compared to traditional gasoline pumps. Even the fastest EV charging station would take up to one hour to charge it completely. This required engineers to work on different aspects in order to improve the scope of EVs. Wireless Power transfer (WPT) is one of the major research areas for EV charging vision. Wireless energy was explained by tesla and has existed since then, but is development has picked up the pace from the last 2 decades. Some research works related to WPT has been going on like, system analysis and control, path guides, antenna optimization, high frequency inverter topologies, etc. Efficient power transfer is achieved at MHz frequency but such high frequency cannot be used to transfer high power. This is due to the limitations of the power electronic components used. MHz frequencies are used for small applications like wireless phone charging, whereas for EV charging frequency range is (3.3kHz-100kHz), frequencies higher than this will increase the losses within the circuit. Various research papers have shown promising result and the current technology needs more and more refinement for making it to the market. The main module utilizes transmitting and receiving coils with air core medium. We know that air core provides loose coupling and coupling coefficient (k) is less than 0.5. It is similar to inductive power transfer (IPT). IPT is in use for many other applications as well. Our work is based on WPT for LD vehicles where we try to use ZVS inverters for high power transfer. This will reduce the charging time and has a potential to be developed as dynamic charging system for the vehicles.

articleTitle: Temperature Analysis of Bldc Motor Used In Electric Vehicle at High Torque Load Using Svpwm Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The electric vehicles (EVs) gain popularity, there is a need for efficient and reliable control techniques for the propulsion system, particularly for the brushless DC (BLDC) motor. The temperature of the BLDC motor is a critical parameter that affects its performance, efficiency, and overall lifespan. This study focuses on analyzing the temperature at various parts of a BLDC motor used in electric vehicle operating under high torque load conditions employing the Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation (SVPWM) control technique. The proposed research aims to investigate the impact of high torque loads on thermal behavior of the BLDC motor and to evaluate the effectiveness of the SVPWM technique in managing temperature rise, the experimental study is carried out and validated with the results.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of On-Board charger integrated with rooftop Solar PV for e-Rickshaw
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Electric Vehicles are slowly replacing conventional vehicles in transportation due to the rising cost of conventional fuel. Energy demand will increase since the penetration of electric vehicles into the public charging system. On vehicle idle condition, the battery is charged from the grid or PV system. MPPT techniques are used to provide and monitor the maximum output of the solar panel to charge the battery. In this article, the PFC and buck converter charge the EV battery through the Grid supply and solar PV. By this topology On-Board charging time is reduced. Mechanical contactors use manual selection to choose the sources. The overall system is simulated by MATLAB/SIMULINK environment, and results are analyzed.

articleTitle: IoT Based Smart Refrigerator and Shopping System Prototype
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The functioning of the “Smart Refrigerator and Shopping System” is discussed herewith. The prototype was built using the ESP32 DEVKIT V1 DOIT as the IoT device and Blynk as the IoT cloud platform, and employs Ai Thinker's ESP32 Cam as the fruit recognition device using Edge Impulse's custom machine learning models. Sensors such as the MQ3 Gas sensor, HR04 Ultrasonic sensor and DHT22 temperature and humidity sensor were used. A shopping system consisting of a barcode and QR code scanner along with an interface for monitoring and purchasing products has also been incorporated. The app prototype is written in Python. It makes use of the Kivy and KivyMD libraries.

articleTitle: Thermal Management Model for Switchgears
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Switchboards need to be designed and customized to suite their ambient conditions which can vary according to location in humidity of coastal regions to high altitude dry mountains, temperatures ranging from subzero environment to 50-60 °C in deserts, irradiation and rain ranging from indoor conditions to outdoor conditions. This technical paper discusses thermal management (TM) model developed for in-panel thermal analysis for selection of rating of breaker, fan characteristics, panel color and dimensions etc. It reduces testing time and associated cost. TM model uses analytical methods, Computational fluid dynamics (CFD), Finite element analysis tools (FEA), IEC, and IEEE standards to predict thermal performance of switchboard operating in various environmental conditions. TM model consists of four submodules- Temperature Rise (TR) module, Micro-ambient (MA) module, solar module, and Re-rating (RR) module. TR module calculates terminal temperature of LV switching device in open air for different links / cable sizes. MA module uses IEC-60890 and CFD simulation to calculate micro-ambient temperature inside panel. Solar module calculates solar heat load on different panel walls using mathematical equations given by the American Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers (ASHRAE). Output from above three modules are used as an input for RR module to estimate temperature of breaker at load current as well as re-rated current for safe operation of switchgears. CFD and FEA simulations helped in validation of this thermal management model.

Author Keywords: Temperature Rise, Micro Ambient module, Rerating Module

articleTitle: A Smart Anti-Collision System for Car Doors
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Currently, both bicycles and motorbikes play a major role in short-distance transportation in cities and the increase in the number of these types of vehicles increases the risk of accidents on the road in the same way that driving a car increases the risk of accidents on the road. Motorcycles and cars have a high percentage of anti-collision accidents when the driver opens the door without first checking the Rear-view mirror for motorcycles approaching. The careless act of opening car doors without caution poses a significant safety risk to cyclists and pedestrians. Therefore, recognition of the rear approaching vehicles has been proposed to reduce accidents. It is composed of an Ultrasonic sensor that detects the speed and distance of a rear object. Sound waves are produced by ultrasonic sensors at frequencies that humans cannot hear and it also consists servo motor to lock the vehicle's door. The servo motor is controlled by Arduino UNO. This anti-collision system is called a Collision Mitigation System. When the servo motor coil is excited then the car door will be automatically locked. To prevent accidents between a motorcycle and a car door, the proposed system is designed to recognize approaching vehicles from behind both day and at night and prevent vehicles from opening the vehicle doorinappropriately to prevent a collision between the motorcycle and the automobile door. This system is more economical and fewer components are used which reduces the cost of the system.

articleTitle: Iot-Based Smart Dam System using STM32F103C8T6 ARM CORTEX and ESP8266
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Maintaining the water level in a dam is really important. The water level in the dam affects the amount of potential energy present to generate electricity, higher water level gives high potential energy. Also, the water level should not rise above the crest of the dam as it increases the risk of bursting the dam and causing major floods in nearby villages and cities. To overcome this problem, we have created a smart dam system using RS-485 serial communication protocol between a single-chip embedded controller ARM cortex STM32F103C8T6 and ESP8266. The water level will be measured using a capacitive sensor connected with STM32. STM32F acts as the master and serially communicates with ESP8266. Servo motor and Infrared sensors will be connected with ESP8266 to open the floodgate and detect the obstacle near the floodgate. The floodgate will be opened automatically based on the water level. The water level and status of the floodgate will be updated lively in a website that we created and a notification will be sent to the locals in case of any emergency due to the water level using IFTTT.

articleTitle: Distribution System Energy Management and Power Quality Improvement by Joint Optimization Procedure
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Distribution system is the fundamental connections that link a utility with its many customers. One of the simplest and most efficient methods for decreasing power loss is restructuring distribution networks. The optimization through reconfiguration has been further improved by integrating capacitor placement as referred as joint optimization procédure. As more and more consumers use non-linear loads, distribution networks are more subjected to harmonic distortion. This could result in significant levels of distortion. Power quality limitations are one of the many different working requirements that are included with the primary goal. Their inclusion is done with the intention of reducing the level of distortion. The primary objective is to cut down on the costs associated with power loss in the distribution system while still adhering to the prescribed levels of power flow, operational efficiency, and power quality. The multi-indicator Stochastic Ranking Algorithm (SRA) is utilised in order to achieve the desired levels of joint optimization procedure. The simultaneous reconfiguration and ideal capacitor placement are handled by SRA. The distribution system's current harmonics are evaluated using the Harmonic Load Flow (HLF). The harmonics are identified and optimised with the help of the HLF in the proposed SRA. The joint optimization procedure through SRA technique that has been proposed is validated with 33 bus IEEE system.

articleTitle: Bijective Soft Set-Based Decision Model for Classification Rule Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Data dissemination is a significant problem in the data mining industry. This is the most difficult task to complete in every subject, including those involving the humanities, social sciences, and the sciences. Tools are needed to efficiently store, retrieve, and analyze the enormous amount of data and information that have been gathered for various objectives. The development of decision models can benefit from a variety of artificial intelligence techniques, such as decision trees, neural networks, rough sets, fuzzy sets and soft sets. One of the cutting-edge techniques is called bijective soft set theory, and it is used to build data reduction, handle information reliance, and deal with data uncertainty. The soft set approach has been used to construct a general model in this research for producing classification rules that can be used for any set of inputs.t.

articleTitle: Design And Implementation of an Optimized Stationary Wireless Power Transfer System for EV Battery Charging
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The paper discusses the urgent need to reduce the environmental impact of internal combustion vehicles (ICVs) through the transition to electric vehicles (EVs). It emphasizes common EV industry issues such as battery life, range anxiety, and charging infrastructure. To address these concerns, the paper focuses on the design of an efficient and quick wireless battery charging system based on inductive coupling and a series-series resonance topology. The wireless power transfer (WPT) system is simulated with MATLAB in order to evaluate its effectiveness in charging EV batteries. A physical prototype of the WPT system for battery charging is also developed and tested. The simulation results are compared and analysed meticulously with the hardware test results in order to provide insights into the feasibility and performance of wireless networks.

articleTitle: Fire Data Acquiring System with Short-Range Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The observation of fire-prone zones via sensors and the preclusion of complications via forecast is highly essential for the security of these areas. Fire sensors are meant to monitor any fire-related events in a room and will convert the data into a digital domain and data will be processed by a microcontroller to decide the fire condition. In the present study, a fire alarm was developed for data acquisition on fire events based on short-range wireless communication networking. Using an RF transceiver data will be shared with the remote display and alarm unit. An AC (220V) current was converted to a DC supply (5V) by scheming a power supply board. The information pertaining to fire was acquired using a photodiode for digitizing it using an Arduino programmed board for processing and showing on LCD. The decision for fire conditions was then determined by writing a program in C language. The output was communicated to a distant and inaccessible location using short-range Zig Bee technology. The sensor was tested for varying fire scenarios. The minimum value on the LCD display depicts the absence of fire near the photo sensor and raising values on the LCD screen marks the presence of fire near the photo sensor.

articleTitle: Fractional order PID controlled bidirectional DC-DC converter for common electric vehicle (EV) charging
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Ongoing research paves the way for LLC-type DC to DC converter between DC source and battery. Identifying a suitable and efficient controller is the prime challenge among research entity. This article introduces a general electric vehicle (EV) charging system that use a single-stage isolated bidirectional DC-DC converter using an LLC-T resonant network. This work primarily analyses the closed loop LLC-T converter developed and tested under MATLAB/SIMULINK environment. The various time-domain parameters such as settling time, steady state error, etc., has been analyzed. The output of the complete DC-DC converter with PI-PI (proportional integral) controller and FOPID-FOPID controller (fractional order proportional integral derivative) is compared to analyze the performance. The proposed controller of the closed loop LLC-T resonant DC-DC converter with FOPID-FOPID has superior performance when compared with the PI PI controller. It also provides many advantages like low volume, low stress, and improved dynamic response compared with existing controllers.

articleTitle: Predicting Diseases Using Chest X-Ray Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Pneumonia and Coronavirus are the key disease that has affected people rapidly in the last couple of years across the globe. Medical Practitioners confirm the diseases using chest X-ray medical images. Computed Radiology, Computer Aided Diagnosis has an edge over the traditional process as it helps to find the ailment at a primary stage, which saves lives at a growing scale day by day. To predict the chest diseases, deep learning methods are promising in predicting the type of chest disease with greater accuracy. In the proposed model to detect chest diseases, DenseNet, Image processing, and deep-learning classification techniques are used. The proposed methodology optimizes the output that includes the inclusion of augmentation layers, dataset filtering, etc., and results in achieving an accuracy of 95.96%.

articleTitle: Modelling a PV Panel Embedded with Phase Change Material (PCM)
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The research aims to investigate the potential of an alternative back sheet of the PV panel based high-density polyethylene (HDPE)/ titanium dioxide (Ti0<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>). This new Phase Change Material (PCM) is targeted to reduce the temperature of the PV panel efficiently compared to an active cooling system. The specific heat capacity and the melting point of the nanocomposite were analyzed to understand its thermal behaviour and properties. Ansys simulation was conducted to identify the potential of HDPE/TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> compared to commercial PV panel back sheets. The results show that the HDPE/TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> composite has better thermal stability and specific heat capacity which leads to providing an efficient heat dissipation medium compared to commercial back sheet material (Tedlar). These findings help to support the potential of the HDPE/TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> composite as a suitable replacement back sheet material in tropical countries.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Powered Learning Pathway Suggestion System
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The use of course recommendation systems to help students make informed judgements about their academic pursuits has increased in the field of education. Traditional centralized recommendation systems, however, are susceptible to security breaches, data manipulation, and privacy violations. To address these issues, this paper proposes a content-based course recommendation system that stores and retrieves course data using the Ethereum blockchain. Using the TF-IDF vectorizer and cosine similarity, the proposed system generates personalized course recommendations based on the user's preferences and interests, which are stored on the blockchain. This method ensures that recommendations are tailored to the specific requirements and preferences of each student, rather than being based on generic data. By utilizing blockchain technology, the system ensures that student data is transparent and tamper-proof, nurturing confidence among students, instructors, and educational institutions. In addition to decentralization, immutability, and transparency, the application of blockchain technology offers additional benefits. Decentralization ensures there is no single point of failure, thereby increasing the system's resistance to attack. Once data is stored on the blockchain, its immutability ensures that it cannot be changed or expunged, providing a high level of data integrity. Transparency ensures that all parties have access to the same information, thereby fostering accountability and confidence. Overall, the proposed content-based course recommendation system offers a personalized and secure approach to course recommendations, while leveraging the advantages of blockchain technology.

articleTitle: Replication and Analysis of Arcing Signal Using Software-Defined Radio Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Arcing signals, commonly observed in electrical systems, pose significant challenges for researchers and engineers seeking to understand their characteristics and behavior. In this research, we present a methodology for studying and replicating arcing signals using Software-defined radio (SDR) techniques. Our approach involves a step-by-step process, encompassing signal analysis, waveform programming, transmission, capture, and validation.

articleTitle: Advancing Sustainability and Resilience in Renewable-Based Hydrogen DC Microgrid: Integrative Power Management with Hybrid Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper introduces an integrated power management approach and strategic control for a standalone hydrogen-based DC micro-grid, which combines PV, wind, and fuel cells, and a hybrid of battery and supercapacitor energy storage. The proposed hybrid energy storage control mitigates the voltage of DC-bus and curtails the battery current stress caused by the intermittency of PV and wind systems. Additionally, the hybrid energy storage controllers are developed using frequency domain analysis. The control algorithm aims to optimize the utilization of PV and wind systems by operating in maximum power point tracking mode, connected to the DC load, using DC-DC converters. Excess power is converted into hydrogen using an electrolyzer and stored for later use in a fuel cell during the period of power deficit. Leveraging the MATLAB/Simulink environment, the suggested system is assessed for efficacy under sudden load changes.

articleTitle: Influence of Oxygen on Dielectric Properties of HFO1336Mzz(E)/CO2 Gas Mixture
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: HFO1336Mzz(E) gas is regarded as a viable replacement gas for SF6 in gas-insulated equipment due to its superior insulating properties and low greenhouse gas potential (Global warming potential, GWP). This study analyses the power frequency breakdown characteristics, charge scattering, and insulation stability of HFO1336mzz(E) under the influence of O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> at different mixing levels. It is concluded that the addition of oxygen enhances the breakdown strength of the proposed gas mixture. The insulation strength of HFO1336Mzz(E) mixture with 2,4,6,8,10 % concentration increases the breakdown voltage by 5.35 %, 8.55%, 12.30%, 14.48%, and 15.10% respectively as compared to HFO1336Mzz(E)-CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> mixture. The insulation stability of the gas mixture is improved with O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> addition up to 8 % above that level, and the stability is reduced. For engineering applications, 2-8% of O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> to the HFO1336Mzz(E)-CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> gas combination is advised to enhance insulating performance.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Land Rover for Disaster Management
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents about the versatile land rover which can travel on off road or on the surface of the different planets or on the surface of natural satellite. The rover is designed in such a way that it has high ground clearance and it supports rocker-bogie system. This land rover is designed to run over on the surface of planets, mining areas, agriculture fields, disaster faced areas in order to collect environmental parameters such temperature, humidity, flammable gases, magnetic field, water, surface altitude, IR radiation, obstacle detecting, light luminance, sound intensity, presence of magnetic material, presence of flame, presence of aliens/ human, heart rate detection of human (if human present in disaster management) etc. This versatile land rover is made to collect environmental parameters and biological parameters in a particular area where human accessible is completely impossible.

articleTitle: Enhanced Fault Localization in Underground Cables Using Varley and Murray Loop Techniques with Remote Monitoring Capability
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Underground cable has been used to transmit power over the overhead lines due to several advantages, such as a lower likelihood of developing faults and better aesthetics. Because it is buried underground, it saves a lot of space as well as lowers the risk of human injury. One of the main disadvantages of underground cable is the ability to determine a fault location since it cannot be seen with the naked eye. The cable thumping method is recognized as one of the highly accurate methods to determine the fault location. However frequent thumping may result in weakening the insulation cable. In this paper, a system with the Varley Loop and Murray Loop methods is proposed to detect the fault location of the underground cable. The purpose of this algorithm is to find the fault accurately while not damaging the underground cable. Varley Loop is more suited for longer cables with higher resistance while Murray Loop is more suited for shorter cables with lower resistance. A physical prototype will be developed that has a remote monitoring capability through an LCD display.

articleTitle: Comparison Between Space Vector Switching Techniques for a Vector Controlled 5-Phase Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Multiphase Induction machines offer several advantages over three phase Induction machines. With the implementation of vector control strategy, the dynamic performance of the 5-phase Induction motor drive can be further enhanced. This research paper focuses on the modelling of a five-phase induction motor and the development of various space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) methods. The SVPWM employed for a vector-controlled drive can improve its behaviour. The SVPWM technique is explained, including the detailed analysis of large space vectors, medium space vectors, and the combination of large and medium space vectors. A comparison is drawn between these different strategies. MATLAB simulations have been carried out to analyse the behaviour of these drives.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Smart Energy Meter for Recording Device-Level Electric Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Traditional energy meter provides the details of the total monthly energy consumption of a premise. It does not provide information about energy consumption at an equipment level. Customers are therefore unable to keep track of the energy used by each piece of equipment. In this paper, an IoT-based energy meter is proposed which is cost-effective, compact, and accurate that can record the energy consumption at the device level as well as the total load. This will help to cultivate the habit of energy conservation in the consumer. Also in the present method of energy recording of a premise, human workers need to go from home to home. The proposed smart energy meter has cloud-based web and mobile application compatibility which can save the human efforts of taking the energy meter readings manually.

articleTitle: Band Gap Modulation of Antidote Super Lattice Armchair Graphene Nanoribbon
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: An effective technique to tune the electronic proper-ties is introducing an antidote in pristine AGNR and producing antidote super lattice AGNRs (ASL-AGNRs). In the present work, we investigate the effect of dimensional parameters on the ASL-AGNR band gap. The numerical tight-binding (TB) approach is applied with two sets of parameters up to the third nearest neighbor. Furthermore, we compare the result with TB parameters which showed excellent agreement with the density functional theory (DFT) result in most cases of ribbon structures, to previously obtained results with TB parameters for only the nearest neighbor and third nearest neighbor.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Based WhatsApp Bot for Plant Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Plant disease lowers the quantity and quality of food, fiber, and biofuel crops, as agriculture tries to feed the world's fast-expanding population. As a result of plant diseases and infections, large-scale farmers and fun-time gardeners face growing concerns about the growth of their plants. Further, many areas do not have access to agricultural testing laboratories or people who can treat the disease. So, we proposed a method wherein any user having a smartphone with WhatsApp installed, can take pictures of the diseased part of the plant and send them to the WhatsApp Bot and the bot sends back the disease-affected areas segmented with the disease type and the probability. The proposed system makes use of HSV Filtering, MobilenetV2, and YoloV8 for disease identification. The algorithms together offer the best and most accurate result. Instance segmentation was used to identify more than one disease appearing on a plant part. As a result, the Chatbot can help the user recognize plant diseases and its cure. The classification model has an accuracy of 95.66% and the segmentation model showed a mAP of 0.756 respectively. Overall, the solution offers portability as farmers need not go to any physical agriculture centers to get plant remedies which can aid the early detection and cure of plant detection with no extra cost.

articleTitle: The Effect of Tactile Stimulation and Imagery for a Brief Vibratory Stimulus on Fingertip
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Tactile Imagery (TI) refers to the cognitive depiction of tactile sensation (TS), even in the absence of any physical stimuli. The potential applications of TI span across various fields, including rehabilitation, virtual reality, and brain-computer interfaces. Studies have shown that imagining vibrotactile stimuli has similar cortical activity to receiving an actual vibration. In the current study, brief vibrotactile stimulation was applied at the digit pads of participants’ left hand to investigate their cortical activity and compare the same with tactile imagery. The result showed an event-related desynchronization (ERD) for both TI and TS with TI showing a pronounced ERD compared to TS.

articleTitle: A Comparative Assessment of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques for Enhanced Home Energy Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The article provides an introduction to the Home Energy Management System (HEMS) and discusses the importance of energy forecasting within the smart grid. HEMS is a crucial application of the smart grid that focuses on managing and optimizing energy consumption within homes.To address the challenges posed by the dynamic nature of energy generation and consumption, the article uses different load forecasting method that incorporates several machine learning techniques, including Linear Regression, Random Forest Regressor, XGBRegressor, Decision Tree, and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). These algorithms are used to forecast the daily energy use and solar power generation for a week. The article emphasizes the importance of taking into account a variety of factors when setting up a microgrid, such as the energy consumption of various home appliances, solar irradiation, and total load. These variables help create a dataset that is then used in the load,solar power and grid price forecasting procedure. The effectiveness of the suggested forecasting algorithms is then demonstrated through comparison and illustration of their efficacy.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Crop Yield Prediction in Agriculture: A Survey in Vellore
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Agriculture is the backbone of any country as it feeds its population. Since the global population keeps increasing, it is necessary to give utmost importance to the field of agriculture. State-of-the-art techniques should be introduced to boost agricultural production multifold. On the other hand, machine learning brings new life to the computing field, which would solve many complex problems in every other field. Machine learning in agriculture based crop yield prediction is the focus of this paper, where significant works are to be explored in this work to understand the commendable outcomes. For this survey, the research articles that have been published in the last five years where vellore a southern Indian district based works are selected and the various aspects of the underlying research and its applications are listed as the outcome of this for the benefit of future budding researchers who would be working in this field of agriculture.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Islanding Detection in Grid connected Distributed Generation with Variants of Decision Tree Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Islanding detection stands as a critical facet within grid-connected distributed generation (DG) systems. These systems harness the source of renewable energies such as solar photovoltaic (PV) panels, wind turbines, or small-scale generators, all interconnected with the primary electrical grid. The concept of islanding arises when a segment of the distributed generation system persists in supplying power to local loads, even when the primary grid has encountered a blackout or fault condition, resulting in its disconnection. Such a scenario can pose safety risks to utility personnel attempting grid repairs and can potentially cause equipment damage if not appropriately managed. This study undertakes a comparative analysis employing various decision tree approaches, namely the Coarse, Medium, and Fine Decision Tree Classifiers. Through extensive simulations, the efficacy of the proposed classifier is rigorously examined, and a comprehensive comparison is established.

articleTitle: Ecoskinomics: Exploring the Ecological Factors Shaping Skin Health
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This comprehensive research paper thoroughly investigates the profound implications of environmental factors on skin health. It meticulously examines the multifaceted contributions of pollution, UV radiation, climate change, and lifestyle choices to adverse skin conditions. The research elucidates the intricate processes driving oxidative stress, inflammation, DNA damage, collagen degradation, and immunosuppression generated by these factors through a comprehensive review of scholarly literature and empirical evidence. It underscores the critical importance of enhancing awareness, implementing evidence-based preventive strategies, and fostering lifestyle modifications to mitigate the detrimental effects and promote optimal skin health in an increasingly challenging environmental landscape.

articleTitle: NLBP - An Improved Local Binary Pattern for Texture Classifcation using Correlational Features of Neighbouring Pixels
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Textural feature extraction concentrates on understanding and capturing the properties of digital images based on the spatial arrangement and relationship between pixels. This technique is applied in numerous applications, such as biometrics, the detection of health conditions, and industrial quality inspections. This paper proposes NLBP (Neighbourhood influenced Local Binary Pattern), an improved Local Binary Pattern based on correlational features between neighbouring pixels. NLBP first divides the grey-level image into overlapping submatrices. The submatrices vary in 3X3, 5X5, and 7X7 windows. Then the centre pixel value of each window is preserved as the threshold value and compared with eight surrounding pixel groups to extract textural information. By substituting the comparison of a single pixel with a set of nearby pixels, the proposed study extracts precise texture information and this algorithm also makes use of various statistical thresholding approaches. The performance of the proposed work was evaluated using KTH and UIUC data-sets under noisy, scaled, illuminated, and rotated conditions which challenges our problem statement. Comparing our work to traditional texture algorithms, it's performance has been improved in various scenarios.

articleTitle: Student Internal Marks Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Nowadays, computers are a need for practically everyone and are employed extensively in all facets of human endeavor. Input, processing, storage, and output are its four fundamental tasks that are shared by all. A computer is a device that is incredibly versatile and outstanding helpful in many facets of the workplace. Schools and universities serve as the cornerstone of information and as a trusted source of instruction for pupils. To keep all the most recent records and make it simple to exchange information with students, they must maintain a proper database of their pupils. This web application called STUDENT INTERNAL MARKS MANAGEMENT SYSTEM mainly uses the CSS, HTML, JAVA SCRIPT as front- end and DJANGO as backend. This web app uses (8000) Local host server to display The web results on our local computer There are three separate logins for this web application: admin, staff, and student logins. Additionally, the student has the choice to read and use his or her results by entering a username and password for secure login, and there is also an option for new student registration. With a manual system, it would be challenging to accomplish this goal because the information is dispersed, sometimes redundant, and gathering pertinent data can take a lot of time. Using this project, all of these issues are resolved. The administrator's job becomes increasingly difficult to manage manually as the institute's student body grows. This computerized approach keeps all the information in a database, making it simple to retrieve and update as necessary

articleTitle: Enhancing the Automotive Software Test Environment Using Continuous Integration and Validation Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Software testing is an integral part of the software development lifecycle, ensuring that software meets quality and functionality requirements. Traditionally, testing has been carried out at specific stages, such as during development or before release. However, this approach often leads to delayed defect detection, increased costs, and reduced overall software quality. To overcome these challenges, the concept of continuous testing has emerged as a critical practice in software testing. Continuous testing (CT) is an iterative and automated process that integrates testing activities throughout the software development cycle. It involves running tests early, frequently, and consistently, enabling immediate feedback on code changes and rapid identification of defects. Continental Automotive introduces a novel solution to address specific project requirements that cannot be fulfilled by Jenkins Due to project dependencies. Introducing the Contest Tool, an internally developed application designed for seamless Continuous Testing. This powerful tool enables downloading of project-specific source application files, seamlessly loading the software to the ECU, conducting comprehensive smoke tests, and generating detailed reports. Moreover, the Contest Tool possesses the unique capability of identifying variances in project-specific checkpoints, allowing for efficient Continuous Testing even when differences arise in the source application files. With its comprehensive features and adaptability, the Contest Tool revolutionizes the testing process, ensuring enhanced quality and reliability in project execution.

articleTitle: DTC-FOC Hybrid Controller to Control the Speed and Torque of BLDC Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper discusses a controller logic for a hybrid field-oriented and direct torque controller, which controls the speed and torque of a BLDC motor drive. The suggested control logic eliminates the implementation challenges while combining the benefits of both Field Oriented Control (FOC) and Direct Torque Control (DTC) methods. A three-phase, two-level inverter with a hall sensor to determine the position of the rotor, switches the current flowing through a coil in a BLDC motor. The controller logic makes the selection of a DTC- FOC hybrid controller based on a threshold value. Using MATLAB simulation, the motor performance has been analyzed with the help of a DTC-FOC hybrid controller technique.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fuzzy Controller for Point Absorber Wave Energy Converter in Irregular Waves
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
