abstract: In this work, the energy conversion from waves into electrical energy using a Point Absorber Wave Energy (PAWE) converter is modelled and controlled. The PAWE converter comprises of a hydraulic pump connected to a motor and a buoy with a generator and controller. To obtain the effect of natural irregular waves, two sinusoidal regular waves of different wavelengths and amplitudes are super-positioned. The spherical shape buoy floats on the surface of the irregular ocean waves. The buoy is connected to a Hydraulic Piston Pump (HPP) where seawater is allowed to flow into the piston pump. Due to the up and down motion of the piston pump, seawater from the piston pump drives the hydraulic motor. The generator coupled to the hydraulic motor yields electrical energy. The output of the point absorber wave energy converter can be varied by controlling the seawater flow into the hydraulic motor. In this paper, conventional PI controllers and Fuzzy gain scheduled PI controllers are developed. By varying the wavelength and amplitude of the irregular wave and the demand torque, the performances of the controllers are evaluated. On comparing the performance of the controllers, it is identified that the fuzzy gain PI controller is adaptive and provides effective control for the point absorber wave energy converter under an irregular wave environment.

articleTitle: Tracking Control of Tello EDU Quadrotor Drone Using Image Thresholding
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In many industries, it is crucial to have an efficient and precise way of monitoring objects or individuals. Drones can be used for this purpose, such as in agriculture, to observe crop growth and detect potential issues. This makes them a valuable tool in different fields, offering greater accuracy and faster data collection. This research uses image thresholding to implement a Tello EDU RoboMaster TT quadrotor drone tracking control system. The goal is for the drone to autonomously follow different line shapes, rounded at different angles, steadily and safely. The drone's camera captures the line's contours using open-source methods, which are processed using image thresholding and binary masking techniques. A control point is generated at the centre of the contours and compared to the centre of the image to guide the drone's movements in real time. The research has successfully enabled the drone to follow lines of various shapes.

articleTitle: Selection of Third Party Logistics (3PL) to Transport Cold Manufactured Items Using MCDM Under Neutrosophic Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Third party logistics (3PL) providers plays an important role in cold item transportation by offering specialized expertise, equipment, service to ensure that the items are transported at the appropriate temperature and arrive in a good condition. This article proposed a problem in selecting 3PL to transport the cold item from a manufacturing company based on different criteria after analyzing the different parameters and ratings of the 3PL. Moreover, the selection process are carried out using MCDM approach namely ARAS to identify the best 3PL under uncertainty. Neutrosophic sets are used to address the uncertainty in the form of data to study about the incomplete and inconsistent information. Single-valued trapezoidal neutrosophic numbers are used to address the incompleteness of the information. Further, the considered problem is solved by the approach of ARAS and also investigated sensitivity analysis which results the best alternatives.

articleTitle: Smart Identity Card for Campus Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: It is developed to ease the work of students by implementing a smart card system. Each student is given a card with a unique identity chip, which can be used for identification, security, and transactions. The system provides increased privacy and security, improves transaction speed, and simplifies campus operations. The system is designed to automate identification and provide easy access to controls and services on campus. The smart card is scanned using an RFID reader, allowing students to carry a single card. Data is not stored directly on the smart card, but rather on a server for an account-based system. The proposed work also includes the creation of a webpage for user credentials and consist of user database where details like marksheet, attendance and record of books taken from library, NFC also stores code for Tap-login to campus system. Additionally, a real-time database will be used to maintain the status of fees, and penalties. A secure portal has been created for file sharing between teachers and students. Student and Teacher have different ID card and permission to access the portal features.

articleTitle: Meaningful Cipher Data Generation: Novel Encipher using Fuzzy Logic For Reducing Cyber Data Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Novel encryption approaches are required to protect the data from the hackers. As per the Palo alto reports, attacks on cipher data increasing over the years. Hackers can access the original data by decrypting it using a variety of techniques. Stealing the encryption key directly is the method that is used most frequently. Intercepting the data is another common method, either before the sender encrypts it or after the recipient decrypts it. A new cipher is proposed in this paper, to improve confidentiality over existing ciphers that produce meaningless and unintelligible formatted ciphers with external key sharing. It causes hackers to begin conducting active attacks through passive attacks, i.e traffic analysis. The proposed cipher combines non-distributable external key sharing and fuzzy logic to generate meaningful cipher images. This approach consists of 4 modules named Rule Base Module, Fuzzification Module, Inference Engine Module and Defuzzification Module. Rule Base consists of user-defined constraints. Fuzzification module performs the encryption process. Inference Engine Module performs the generation of Meaningful cipher images. Defuzzification module performs Key Extraction and Decryption of the image. The security and confidentiality of images are greatly reliant on key management. Here, the key is not distributed which provides controlled access and reduces the key exposure. The combination of fuzzy logic and non-distributable external key sharing provides a better solution for protecting image confidentiality. The proposed approach performance is measured in terms of various metrics such as Mean squared error, Structured Similarity Index, and Histogram analysis.

articleTitle: Multimode Interference Based Narrow Spectral Width Bandpass Fiber Optic Filter Using NCF-FMF Combinations
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this research, we present the conceptualization and implementation of a multimode interference filter using novel specialty fiber combinations to achieve a narrow transmission bandwidth with minimal insertion loss. The filter structure comprises no-core, few-mode (NCF-FMF) fibers sandwiched between two single-mode fibers to realize the multimode interference effect. The proposed filter exhibits an insertion loss of about 0.37 dB and a narrow 3-dB spectral width of 3.6 nm at the center wavelength of 1029.56 nm. To mitigate the interference between wavelength-division multiplexing channels, isolation of about 40 dB is achieved over a wavelength span of about 45 nm. In addition to its significant application in spectroscopy and sensing, the filter has the potential to be employed in the domain of fiber-optic communications and LIDARs.

articleTitle: Power System Harmonic Estimation using Whale Optimization Algorithm and Least Square Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The accurate estimation of harmonic components is crucial for analyzing and mitigating power system distortions, ensuring the reliable operation of electrical networks. In this paper, we present a novel approach called Optimal Harmonic Estimation (OHE) that addresses the challenges of accurately estimating harmonic content in power systems. OHE leverages advanced optimization techniques to overcome the limitations of traditional methods and provides robust and precise harmonic estimation results. In this paper we combine Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) and Recursive Least Square (RLS) approach for facilitating efficient power system harmonic analysis. The proposed approach shows promising potential for harmonic estimation.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Smart Home Desktop Assistant
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In recent years, one of the main components of industry 4.0 is Internet of Things has witnessed rapid growth in almost every field, from agriculture, manufacturing, medical, education, smart cities IOT has made all things more interconnected, easy to access and brought all things under our fingers. One of the most widely use cases of IOT is home automation. Home automation now a days is very popular as we can control devices remotely, enhances security, save energy, etc. In this paper we have proposed one step up of home automation version using desktop assistant “Jarvis” and some additional features like medical chatbot. Jarvis is a fully GUI based desktop assistant which can access different websites over the internet, it can also interact with the microcontrollers to control different devices. Using desktop assistant Jarvis, we can control the home devices remotely through our voice, and applications like reading news, accessing emails, accessing google, opening any folder or file in desktop, interacting with cloud, opening different websites, sending messages, taking screenshots, creating notes, responding like humans in real time via speakers, accessing camera of the laptop, online shopping, etc. are possible using our prototype.

articleTitle: Intelligent Trip Planning with Integrated Street View: A Seamless AI-driven Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The advent and widespread adoption of AI-powered trip planners have revolutionized how travelers engage in travel planning. These intelligent systems leverage artificial intelligence algorithms and data to provide users with personalized, efficient, and immersive planning experiences. In this research the indispensable role played by immersive street view experiences within AI trip planners. Integrating immersive street view experiences within AI trip planners empowers travelers to make well-informed choices, as they can virtually navigate and assess potential destinations, accommodations, and attractions. These intelligent systems leverage artificial intelligence algorithms and data to provide users with personalized, efficient, and immersive planning experiences. The findings reveal that immersive street view experiences significantly elevate the effectiveness of travel planning and decision-making processes.

articleTitle: Advancing Parkinson's Disease Diagnosis with Self- Adaptive Convolutional Neural Networks through MRI Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a progressive and degenerative neurological disorder that primarily disrupts the brain's motor functions, leading to symptoms like brady kinesia, stiffness, balance problems, and resting tremors. The intricate nature of PD, which often resembles other neurological conditions and involves subtle structural brain changes, complicates accurate diagnosis, resulting in a 25% diagnostic error rate. To address this challenge, the research community has employed various machine learning techniques using manually crafted features for diagnosis. This study introduces an innovative computer- aided diagnostic approach for PD based on a self-adaptive convolutional neural network (SCNN), a potent model for automatically extracting essential problem features. The Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI) provided the dataset used in this investigation, which includes a variety of datasets such as T2-weighted MRI scans from both PD individuals as well as healthy controls (HC). In particular, mid- slice MRI data is gathered and registered in order to be aligned. To pinpoint the region of interest in the midbrain, a 33 × 33-sized window is employed, as PD primarily affects the substantia nigra within the midbrain. Comprehensive experiments have been conducted to validate the reliability of the SCNN approach. Using common evaluation measures like area under the curve, specificity, sensitivity, and accuracy, the suggested method's performance is evaluated. Notably, the evaluation findings show that in terms of diagnostic precision, the SCNN performs better than other machine learning techniques.

articleTitle: Assessing the Feasibility and Optimizing Capacity for Solar-Wind Hybrid Renewable Energy Systems for Remote Area
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Energy drives economic growth through the introduction of the necessary inputs for a nation's socio-economic development. Due to the scarcity of fossil fuels and rising carbon emissions, there is an ever-increasing demand for renewable energy. In order to meet the electrical load requirement of Ujjain Rd, Vikram Nagar, Uttam Nagar, Dewas, Madhya Pradesh 455001, India, this article seeks to determine the best hybrid technology combo for producing electricity using different forms of renewable energy. In this research work HOMER PRO which is used as programmer functions as a tool for sizing and optimization. The best and most practical renewable energy system for the chosen site is the hybrid system, which has a COE of ∃0.291 and an NPC of ∃15,467 in addition to an initial cost of ∃8,590. The solar renewable data for the chosen location is 5.17 KWh/m2/day, while the wind renewable data is 5.47 m/s. System is superior and environmentally benign compared to the 220 kg/yr of carbon emissions.

articleTitle: Modified Lookup Table for Reduced Torque Ripple in a Direct Torque Controlled PMSM Drive
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: One of the most intriguing high-performance control approaches used today is Direct Torque Control (DTC) for variable speed drives. For several applications, permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSM) are gradually taking the place of induction motors (IMs) because of their advantageous qualities, especially their increased effectiveness and small size. DTC controlled PMSM drive employs dual hysteresis controllers and a selection mechanism, such as a switching table, to determine the optimal voltage vector for satisfying torque and flux criteria. Disadvantages of a DTC system are the presence of undesirable fluctuations in torque and flux, as well as the issue of varying switching frequencies. In this paper, analysis of integral sliding mode controller (ISMC) and the super-twisting sliding mode controller (STSMC) has been presented for torque ripple reduction. This paper also illustrates the use of a unique converter switching table for the reduction of torque ripple.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization-Extreme Learning Machine Model Combined With the Gradient Boost Algorithm for Short-Term Wind Power Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Accurate wind power assesses are fundamental to maximizing the use of wind power and defend a safe and reliable electricity grid. Gradient boosting algorithm with a limit learning machine optimized using particle swarm optimization (PSO-ELM), taking into account the inherent unpredictability and variability of wind power as well as the limitations of existing forecasting models. A Gradient Boost technique is then used to generate a large number of PSO-ELM weak predictors. Input weights and thresholds of each weak predictor, which each includes a unique hidden layer node. The results from each weak predictor are combined and weighed to get the final forecast result using a robust wind power forecast model. We use measured data from Turkish wind turbines to verify the efficacy of our suggested strategy. The findings demonstrate that the Gradient-PSO-ELM wind power prediction model has improved generalizability and accuracy than the Random forest.

articleTitle: A New Configurable SC-based MLI Topology with Lower Device Count
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In power electronics research, the switched-capacitor (SC) unit integrated multilevel inverters (MLIs) have have received a lot of attention from researchers during the last few years. The SC-MLI is a more desirable converter than its other accessible counterparts for a variety of applications due to its inductorless and transformerless operation, intrinsic capacitor self-voltage balancing performance, and voltage-boosting features. This, together with a reduction in electromagnetic interference, makes the SC-MLI a smart choice. In the present article, an improved circuit of MLI topology has been designed with a configurable voltage levels and voltage gain. A voltage gain of 1.5 and 2.5 can be achived with the number of levels being seven and six, respectively. This change in the level count and gain is based on charging pattern of SC units. The designed topology has been simulated in PLECS with various working environments to show the performance.

articleTitle: 360-Degree Disinfection Box using Ultraviolet Sterilization with IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This study presents a novel approach to preventing the spread of Covid-19 through physical contact by designing a sterilization box that incorporates UV-C shortwave radiation. The box is controlled by an ATmega2560 microcontroller which enhances its efficiency. To avoid transmission through touch, we developed an IoT system that enables users to access the sterilization box using a mobile application on their smart devices without the necessity of physical contact with the device. By utilizing a Bluetooth HC-05 module, the tool can be controlled using a smartphone, thereby reducing the risk of Covid-19 transmission through physical contact. This novel approach proves to be an efficient method in mitigating the transmission of Covid-19 and can potentially be implemented in public spaces in order to minimize the chances of transmission.

articleTitle: Auotomatic Railway Track Crack Detection and Alert System
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: For both long-distance and suburban traffic, railroads offer the least expensive and most practical form of passenger transportation. In addition, India's railway system handles most of the country's carriers. The main issue about railway track crossings and undetected cracks in Indian railway tracks is still accidents. Approximately 60% accidents happen at railway crossings and also due to rail track fracture, which costs both valuable lives and money. Therefore, it is necessary to consider new technology that is reliable, effective, and steady for detection on railway tracks. This project's primary goal is to develop a successful functioning prototype that can detect the railway track cracks utilizing LIDAR sensors, employing a dynamic approach that integrates GPS tracking and WIFI modules to transmit alert messages along with the geographical coordinates of the location. An Arduino Uno is employed to manage and synchronize the functionalities of these devices. LIDAR, a remote sensing technique, measures distance by analyzing the time-of-flight (TOF) of unmodulated narrow light pulse echoes reflected from the target.

articleTitle: Implementation of Industrial Automation Pyramid
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: There are many energy flexibility measures used in industrial demand response. Various production IT systems are essential for their planning and control. In companies, the hierarchy of automation is being redefined. widely accepted as a method of categorizing these in-house IT systems. As a consequence of this paper, the notion has expanded to encompass IT systems that enhance and capitalize on a company's energy flexibility, encompassing energy markets and aggregators. that enable the company to refine and monetize its energy flexibility. A comprehensive approach is adopted to present a representative classification of industrial demand response functionality.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Classification in Insulation Material via Discrete Wavelet Transform Noise Reduction and Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Insulation material degradation stemming from partial discharge (PD) is a major factor in power equipment failure. External electromagnetic interference introduces noise, compromising the accuracy of PD diagnosis, thus, addressing partial discharge noise suppression is crucial. This study examines four PD types which include corona, floating electrode, surface, and void discharge measured from insulation materials. PD signals were combined with Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) and treated with Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) for noise reduction. Six features including root mean square error, variance, standard deviation, waveform factor, kurtosis, and skewness were extracted from denoised signals to classify PD types using Artificial Neural Network (ANN) with 10-fold cross-validation. Classification accuracy was assessed and compared. Results indicate effective AWGN removal by DWT, achieving up to 90% classification accuracy for PD defects post-noise reduction using ANN.

articleTitle: Power Quality Perspective: Impact Analysis of Electric Vehicles Penetration in Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The rapid proliferation of Electric Vehicles (EVs) is transforming the transportation landscape, offering a promising solution to reduce the heavy dependence on fossil fuel-powered vehicles. As the demand for EVs increases, so does the necessity for efficient and reliable charging infrastructure. EVs are typically connected to the grid for charging, leading to the emergence of nonlinear loads and power electronic devices. Consequently, harmonics are introduced into the distribution systems, potentially impacting power quality in the grid. This work analyses the impacts of electric vehicle charging systems in a grid from a power quality perspective. In the MATLAB model, a 3-phase supply is connected to an Electric Vehicle (EV) battery of standard specifications. The model comprises a rectifier that converts AC to DC and a Buck converter that reduces the rectified voltage to the required battery voltage. This paper uses the Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) technique to focus on harmonic mitigation. The simulation results of the source current are analyzed to study the harmonic reduction, and FFT analysis is performed to find the Total Harmonic Distortion (THD).

articleTitle: A Novel Fuzzy-based Traveling Salesman Approach for Emergency Routing under Disaster Scenario
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Governments can face significant financial and human losses during natural disasters such as earthquakes, floods, and hurricanes. These unpredictable events trigger emergencies that cause damage to infrastructure. In order to aid victims and minimize negative impacts, it is crucial to have efficient logistical efforts to transport supplies and equipment. However, optimizing logistics during disasters is challenging, as traditional techniques like the Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP) require solving complex optimization problems. Researchers are exploring alternative solutions to overcome this challenge to quickly identify the best possible solution. The TSP is a well-known optimization problem where a salesman needs to visit a set of cities and return to the starting city, minimizing the total distance traveled. In the context of emergency routing during a Turkey earthquake, the goal is to efficiently allocate emergency resources and plan routes for emergency responders to reach affected areas. Hexagonal fuzzy numbers (HFNs) can be used to represent uncertain information, such as the severity of damage or the availability of resources in different areas affected by the earthquake. By incorporating fuzzy numbers into the TSP model, we can account for the uncertainty and make more informed decisions in emergency routing. This approach can help minimize response time, allocate resources effectively, and ensure that emergency responders reach affected areas in a timely manner. This paper focuses on addressing the symmetric TSP using HFNs in a specific scenario involving eleven earthquake-affected districts in Turkey. The problem involves utilizing geographical coordinates to determine the most efficient route for distributing emergency supplies in the region.

articleTitle: Influence of Harmonic Voltages on the PD Characteristics of Nano Modified Sunflower oil
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Insulation in a transformer plays a crucial role in maintaining electrical isolation between different components and windings, ensuring safe and efficient operation. Mineral oil is used as an insulation and cooling medium in transformer. It is a non-biodegradable substance and can persist in the environment for a long time if released or leaked. Therefore Sunflower oil is used as an alternate for mineral oil. However, harmonic distortion is a common issue in power systems, which can cause an increase in dielectric loss and partial discharge activity, leading to insulation failure and equipment damage. Therefore, the investigation of the PD performance of pure Sunflower oil under different harmonic AC voltages is essential for ensuring the reliable and safe operation of electrical equipment. On this paper, the work is finished to have a look at the partial discharge traits of sunflower oil based nanofluid beneath harmonic AC voltages. That is the aggregate of pure sunflower oil and SiO2 nanoparticles. A nanofluid with a mass ratio of 0.01% and 0.05% sunflower oil are mixed. The PD traits were analyzed for Partial Discharge importance, initial voltage, boost time, peak height amplitude, Phase-Resolved PD sample, and frequency and time plots of Partial Discharge signal. All experiments were performed according to IEC standards. Outcomes of Nano blended sunflower oil are in comparison with natural sunflower edible oil. The partial discharge experiments within the Sunflower oil were carried out under specific kinds of harmonic superimposed AC Voltages. Harmonic order of 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> and 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> is applied. The effects show that: a) the PDIV value decreases as the harmonic order increase when using an AC voltage with superimposed harmonics b) PD styles are intently associated with the waveform of carried out voltage, and Silica introduced sunflower oil indicates lesser PD amplitude, pulse duration, duration (time length) while in comparison with the pure sunflower oil.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Performance Analysis of Carbon Quantum Dots Modified Mineral Oil
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Mineral oil is commonly used as an insulating medium in power transformers and other high-voltage equipment. It exhibits good insulating properties and provides cooling for the equipment. However, over time, mineral oil can undergo ageing processes due to factors such as temperature, oxidation, and contamination, which can affect its performance and electrical properties. CQD-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> (Carbon Quantum Dot-Silicon Dioxide) is a compound containing quantum dots (QDs) embedded in a silicon dioxide (SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) matrix. These quantum dots subsist nanoscale semiconducting particles that can exhibit unique electrical and optical properties. When mineral oil is used as an insulating medium in conjunction with CQD-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> nanoparticles, the ageing process can affect the partial discharge characteristics which in turn reduces the efficiency. Partial discharge (PD) is the portion of the discharge that occurs in electrical insulating materials. This paper investigates the partial discharge (PD) characteristics by changing the concentration of carbon quantum dots (CQDs- Sio<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) in mineral oil.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study of Wind Turbine Generator for Potential Onshore Installation in Malaysia
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This-paper presents a comprehensive study on the feasibility of wind turbine integration in Malaysia, where generally low-wind speeds prevail, but certain locations experience higher than average wind speeds, making them potential sites for wind farms. The project aims to identify suitable locations for wind turbine implementation and select an appropriate model from the mesoscale wind turbines (ranging from 100 kW to 500 kW) using HOMER Pro software. The study focuses on determining the optimal sizing and location of wind turbine generators and their seamless integration into the grid. Behavior of the grid before and after renewable energy integration is then observed utilizing the 26-bus system. Power flow analysis software PSS/E is employed for system constraint analysis, including voltage and thermal limits, and power losses in the system. Further optimization is carried out to obtain an optimized grid, efficiently integrated with the selected wind turbine generator. The results of this study will provide valuable insights for the practical implementation of wind turbine systems in Malaysia, contributing to sustainable energy generation and grid stability.

articleTitle: An Analytical Study for the Realization of Maximum Efficiency in Wireless Charging System Using a Circular Inductive Coil
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The growth of wireless charging technology is increasing due to its efficient power transmission from a few millimeters to several centimeters. Thus, wireless power transfer (WPT) techniques are highly recommended for electric vehicle (EV) battery charging. However, the degradation of transmission efficiency occurs during misalignment among coupling coils. Therefore, the design of coupling coils requires the proper coil geometry such as coil shape, coil turn, coil diameter, and the distance between the turns. In this article, the analytical model of asymmetrical circular coils is taken into consideration to explore the relationship between the coil geometry and mutual inductance and coupling coefficient with identical inner and outer diameters. With this, an inductively coupled resonance power transmission technique is analyzed and simulated by varying the key parameters of coil geometry using MATLAB/Simulink software. The simulated results are examined to calculate the power transmission distance, load resistor, coil geometry, air gap between the coils, and the effect of charging efficiency. It is concluded from the result that the power transmission distance, choice of coil dimensions, and distance between the turns influenced the quality factor, coupling coefficient, mutual inductance, operating frequency, and power transmission efficiency. From the analytical model, the maximum power transmission efficiency is achieved by selecting the optimum values of the design parameters.

articleTitle: Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy using SVM and Random Forest Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Fundus images of the human eye play a major role in detecting retinal disorders at an early stage, in diabetic patients, so that with proper medication ophthalmologists try to reduce vision loss. These images provide ophthalmic conditions of patients and also the insights of cardiovascular defects in blood vessels of the eye. Though manual assessment is a simple process but lack of sufficient number of ophthalmologists and expertise needed is a major task to detect at an early stage. Hence with the help of machine learning algorithms through image processing techniques were gaining importance in disease detection. However, these images have to go through pre- processing techniques with filters and contrast enhancement techniques to have an easy analysis. This work tries to apply image enhancement techniques and uses machine learning algorithms to train the model and predict the accuracy of the Images. This also determines which is effectively and accurately classifying the retinal images which is having the retinal disorder caused by Diabetics known as Diabetic Retinopathy.

articleTitle: Automated Teller Machine Security and Robbery Prevention Based on Human Behaviour Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The suggested approach offers a way to stop people from stealing money from ATMs. Criminals steal money from ATMs in a number of ways. The suggested approach seeks to avoid all of these tactics, including the most popular one employed by criminals: stabbing victims, even though there isn't a workable solution. The cash was taken. Preventing and early detection of ATM fraud are the project's primary goals. Our system, which was created using streams combined as a single entity to identify human activity using deep learning and ATM surveillance cameras, has offered answers for some of the common cases of various sorts of ATM fraud occurrences in different countries. Even though ATMs have security cameras, theft and other crimes still commonly occur in these machines since the cameras are not effectively integrated to catch these crimes. Several image processing methods can be used to identify a person wearing a helmet, faces that are covered, and other unusual characteristics. This study recommends a model to detect weapon detection, camera manipulation, and human behavioural analysis in order to catch the theft sooner.

articleTitle: High Resolution Low Altitude 2D Map Reconstruction Using UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In the contemporary era, with the ready availability of high-resolution and real-time satellite imagery, the field of low-altitude mapping remains an area yet to be resolved. In this study, the aim was set to reconstruct maps utilizing aerial images obtained from Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) through the utilization of open-source tools. Furthermore, an analysis of the influence of flight altitude and speed was undertaken. Promising results were achieved as maps were successfully generated not only from vertically captured videos but also from overhead videos. Additionally, a comprehensive analysis was conducted to partially elucidate the impact of flight altitude on the quality of the captured images. Through this research, an expansion of mapping techniques was enabled by harnessing the capabilities of UAVs and open-source tools, thereby introducing a new dimension to cartography. The importance of considering flight parameters such as altitude and speed for optimizing map reconstruction from low-altitude sources was underscored by the findings. These outcomes carry significant potential for various applications, including environmental monitoring, disaster management, and urban planning.

articleTitle: Double-Tuned Harmonic Passive Filter Design for Harmonic Mitigation at LV Distribution Network Caused by Electric Vehicle On-Board Charger
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The electrical system's power quality is impacted by the presence of electric vehicle (EV) on-board chargers, as they generate harmonic currents. The connecting EV on-board charging loads will result in the generation of 3rd and 5th harmonic currents in the low voltage line. In this paper, the harmonic analysis of an EV on-board charging system is examined. The EV on-board charging load's harmonic current distortion was discovered to be greater than the IEEE standard 519-2014 THDv, TDDi, and IHDi standards. To mitigate the harmonic currents, a double-tuned harmonic passive filter was used and implemented on the LV lines. MATLAB/Simulink is used to simulate the setup of double-tuned harmonic passive filter in power system with a connected EV on-board charging load. According to the results of the harmonic current mitigation during maximum charging conditions, the developed filter may lower THDv and TDDi to respective values of 8.00% and 4.17%. Besides that, the 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup>, 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> and 7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> IHDi is reduced to 0.90%, 0.10 and 1.67% respectively which correspond to the recommended limitations of IEEE standard 519-2014 with the double-tuned harmonic passive filter that was showed, the maximum number of EVs could be connected to the LV line.

articleTitle: Vibration Analysis of BLDC Motor Used in Electric Vehicle at High Torque Load
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The vibration analysis of a brushless direct current (BLDC) motor widely used in electric vehicles (EVs) due its reliable performance and durability. This study focuses on investigating the vibration anlysis of a BLDC motor operating under high torque loads in EVs. The outcomes of this research contribute to the improvement of BLDC motor efficiency in electric vehicles. The main objective is to enhance the performance, reliability, and lifespan of the BLDC motors. The PWM Technique and SVPWM technique is employed to control the motor and regulate ripple torque with vibration, the results obtained and compared experimentally.

articleTitle: Design and Characterization of Standard Cell Libraries for Optimal Subthreshold Circuits
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Subthreshold operation is proved to be one of the most attractive approaches to achieve low power consumption with the trade-off in performance. Sizing of short channel devices operated in subthreshold region is very important for optimum power and performance of digital circuits. In this paper, the impact of Reverse Short Channel Effect (RCSE) and Inverse Narrow Width Effect (INWE) on the device I-V characteristics under subthreshold region is studied. Standard cell library suitable for subthreshold circuits by choosing optimum device sizing to achieve low power and high drive current by utilizing RSCE and INWE aware has been designed. The performance analysis and comparison of these two standard cell library-based circuits have been carried out. The standard cell library using conventional device sizing is also included for comparison. All the standard cell library design and characterization has been carried out using CADENCE LIBERATE tool. All the circuits are designed in VIRTUSO using 90nm CMOS technology from UMC. An 8-bit booth multiplier has been used as a benchmark circuit and synthesized using all the three standard cell libraries. Simulation results show that the multiplier synthesized using INWE based standard cell library has achieved 8.53% lesser power and 17.53% lesser area when compared to conventional sizing based standard cell library. Simultaneously, multiplier synthesized using RCSE aware standard cell library has achieved 15.2% lesser delay when compared to conventional sizing based standard cell library multiplier.

articleTitle: Automated Defects Classification of Photovoltaic Modules Using YOLOV7 Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The widespread adoption of photovoltaic (PV) systems for renewable energy generation has highlighted the importance of maintaining optimal performance and reliability of PV modules. The classification of defects in PV modules is crucial for effective maintenance and improved system performance. Electroluminescence (EL) imaging is one of the important techniques for the inspection of PV modules. This work aims to develop a deep learning-based classification model to categorize defects in photovoltaic modules. This work proposed a YOLOv7 model for automated classification of defects on PV modules. The experimental results demonstrated the proposed YOLOV7 model achieved mAP of 99% in classifying the PV defects into 3 classes (mode A, mode B and mode C).

articleTitle: Bidirectional Wireless Charging for Vehicle to Grid and Vehicle to Vehicle Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The future scenario for Electric Vehicle (EV) is self-driving automated system where the charging of the EV also has to do without the need for human interaction. There is a demand for a fully automated system with quick, safe, cost-effective, and dependable charging infrastructure with a stable business model for rapid adoption in electric transportation systems. Wireless charging (WC) is a futuristic technology that offers flexibility, convenience, safety, and the capacity to become automated to make the system more adaptable. Among the several WC topologies, the Inductive wireless power transfer (IWPT) approach is generally used due to its high-power handling capacity and high efficiency. This paper throws light on the EV charging technologies and their standards. Among that Series-Series resonant IWPT have been chosen for implementation and a 10kW converter is designed and analyzed.

articleTitle: ANN Based Fake Profile Detection and Categorization Using Premetric Paradigms On Instagram
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This study, focused on the behavioral analysis for the identification of social media accounts, endeavors to discern counterfeit profiles within social media networks by employing machine learning methodologies. The investigation is underpinned by a comprehensive dataset encompassing various user behavior-related attributes, including but not limited to the count of followers, followings, posts, private account status, and other relevant factors. The data is subjected to rigorous preprocessing procedures, which involve feature scaling and the division of the dataset into distinct training and testing subsets. Subsequently, a neural network model is trained utilizing the training dataset and rigorously evaluated using performance metrics such as accuracy and loss on the testing dataset. Additionally, the study delves into an examination of the confusion matrix to provide insight into the classification performance and offers a visual representation of the distribution of genuine and counterfeit accounts. The experimental results substantiate the model's efficacy in successfully identifying fake accounts through an in-depth analysis of their behavioral patterns.

articleTitle: Real Time Surveillance and Cleaning Bot - Vacurity
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The ever-increasing demand for efficient and adaptable solutions in smart living spaces has led to the development of integrated technologies that cater to both security and cleanliness requirements. This paper introduces a novel integrated system that consist of ESP32-CAM for surveillance, Arduino for bot and vacuum cleaner control, and an ultrasonic sensor for autonomous operation. The system addresses the demands of efficient security and cleanliness in smart living spaces. An essential feature of the integrated system is its versatility in operation. The bot can be seamlessly operated manually or automatically for continuous surveillance and cleaning using Vacurity app. Evaluation demonstrated effective real-time detection of obstacle, surveillance and maintained cleanliness, making it a powerful and cost-effective solution for smart living spaces.

articleTitle: Comparsion Study of Conventional, & Improved Perturb and Observe to Charge an EV Battery
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper, a comparison study had been imple- mented between the Conventional and Improved P O. It has been implemented for a Xiaomi MI Electric Pro 2 Battery as a load with variable solar irradiance and temperature. The Comparison had been done by taking the response time of each algorithm to reach the Maximum power point (MPP). The Conventional P O is a straightforward way where the algorithm will compare the power and voltage from the previous value and then increase or decrease the pointer to the maximum power value. While on the other side, the Improved P O will decrease the time to reach Maximum power. The model had been implemented in MATLAB simulink.

articleTitle: A Review on Solar-Based High Gain DC/DC Converters for Microgrid Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper briefly views DC/DC converters for high voltage gain conversion ratio. The converter operation is analyzed during continuous conduction mode (CCM) and discontinuous conduction mode (DCM). The converters' design procedure and theoretical analysis are explained with mathematical expressions. A high gain is obtained with less voltage stress across switches. The optimum switched inductor and switched capacitor design are adjourned as the cause for this phenomenon. Similarly, other converters have advantages such as low component count, effective step response and reduced losses across diodes. The step response is a prominent characteristic of designed DC/DC converters for microgrid applications. This is achieved by CCM and DCM modes of operation with proper converter control strategy.

articleTitle: Combined kiloWatt And negaWatt Trading with Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Generation of renewable energy by participants in the electricity market is used for self-consumption and for local trade. Energy savings can be turned into negative watts-negawatts- and can be traded with peers as the right to purchase electricity. Combining both kilowatt and negawatt trading would enhance the local energy market by providing peers with better access to energy and economic benefits. Trust in the market could be managed effectively with the help of blockchain technology. Market transactions are recorded into immutable, transparent, and distributed ledgers, with added security provided by tokenization. In this work, a combined kiloWatt and negawatts trading is attempted in a local market with solar electricity generation, enabled by smart contract deployed on public blockchain. Smart contracts are written in Solidity language and deployed on Sepolia test network for Ethereum public blockchain.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of TAR PWM Scheme For 7 Level Asymmetrical Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This study introduces an innovative Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) technique aimed at enhancing the performance of a 7-level asymmetrical source inverter (7LASI) that employs two DC sources in a 1:2 sequence. In contrast to the conventional Sinusoidal Pulse Width Modulation (SPWM) technique, this novel PWM approach is designed to improve voltage quality and overall harmonic spectra. The gate signals for the proposed PWM are generated through a modified PWM scheme, incorporating a combination of a trapezoidal amalgamated rectangular (TAR) modulating waveform and a traditional triangular carrier waveform. These TAR level-shifted PWM schemes are employed to generate triggering pulses for the 7LASI. Various performance indicators are evaluated across different modulation indices, and comparative results are presented in comparison to conventional PWM techniques. The findings indicate that the proposed TAR PWM method consistently outperforms conventional SPWM. To conduct the simulation study, MATLAB-SIMULINK is utilized as the primary tool. This research presents a significant advancement in inverter technology, with the potential to greatly enhance voltage quality and reduce harmonic distortions in power systems.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of IOT-based Solar Dryer for Sustainable Farming
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this work, an indirect type solar dryer was developed using an Evacuated tube-based compound parabolic concentrator incorporated with PCM based latent heat thermal energy storage system. Without a tracking system, the absorber can collect direct and diffused ration by concentrating the solar radiation by assembling the two parabolas with compound rotation. The charging loop was built to maintain the proper heat collection from the solar collector. The heat transfer fluid pumped into the solar collector gains the heat by convection heat transfer mode. The heat transfer fluid flow inside the shell and tube Latent heat thermal energy storage system from the top transfer into the punch of tubes assembled parallel. Paraffin wax, due to its higher melting temperature and the latent heat of fusion, increases with an elongated hydrogen and carbon chain and is also a cost-effective, reliable, non-reactive material with self-nucleating properties. By implementing tubular encapsulation, direct contact between the PCM and the HTF is prevented, minimizing chemical reactions and enhancing PCM handling. Integrating a Thermal energy storage system into the solar dryer eliminates the fluctuation of solar radiation during non-sun shine hours, which helps prevent microbial growth. A power-full hard drive was developed especially for the energy-efficient loT application. It has many features like low power, being a cost-effective platform, being integrated into Wi-Fi, containing a dual-core processor and having many input/output pins called GPIO (General Purpose Input/Output) to connect the sensor and control units. This system presented in this work assists in monitoring the system and controlling various vital parameters. This system would help small-scale farmers dry grains and monitor the system at a relatively cheaper cost.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Popularity Assessment and Energy Efficiency of Electronic Billboards through Smart Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In the realm of digital content, platforms like YouTube and Facebook have introduced diverse methods for gauging popularity. Curiously, no effective solution exists for assessing the popularity of electronic billboards. In response, our work introduces a groundbreaking concept: a smart billboard empowered to measure its own popularity based on its location's engagement. This work presents an innovative approach that not only evaluates electronic billboard popularity but also curtails energy consumption in the display. By integrating passive infrared (PIR) motion sensors and advanced object detection, our smart Internet of Things (IoT) control system collaborates seamlessly with an attentive electronic billboard setup. The combined data of viewer counts, and foot traffic discern the advertisement's effectiveness. The system proposed consists of a Raspberry Pi 3B alongside a monitor, Pi camera, and dual PIR motion sensors. The system interfaces with Telegram for comprehensive control. Empirical data were meticulously collected across varied schedules and 2 locations within the Multimedia University Cyberjaya campus. The extensive experimental results show that the popularity of the billboards is successfully accessed through the system proposed. Notably, the system harnessed energy savings by judiciously turning off displays during periods of inactivity, culminating in a commendable energy conservation of 18.52W over a four-hour duration. This study pioneers a cost-effective technique that harnesses object detection and motion sensing to precisely assess the popularity of electronic billboard advertisements. Beyond this innovation, the system's intelligent energy optimization profoundly impacts the environment, fostering sustainable and economically viable out-of-home advertising practices.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis of Topic Categorization Using PaLM, GPT and BERT Models
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Topic Categorization is a crucial task for organizing and managing information. It is very useful for making it easier to find and retrieve relevant documents. In a mode of digital world filled with information, topic categorization plays pivotal role in many aspects. Numerous number of models were introduced in order to categorize the topics using various datasets whereas PaLM, BERT and GPT models are all large language models (LLM) that have been developed in the recent years. These models can learn the statistical relationships between words and phrases, which allows them to identify the topics that are discussed in a document with greater accuracy. They can also process large amounts of text data quickly, which is important for applications that require real-time topic categorization. Additionally, they are more robust to noise and errors than traditional methods. As these models continue to develop, they are likely to become even more effective at topic categorization. A comparative study has been made among PaLM, BERT and GPT language models for topic categorization using AG News Dataset in this paper. The results are promising and encouraging where the suggested models provides more precise categorization for text of the dataset.

articleTitle: A Review on Deep Learning-Based Face Recognition Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Face recognition is one of computer vision's most ac-tive research areas. The efficiency of numerous facial recognition techniques has skyrocketed with the emergence of deep learning, which has opened up new possibilities. Considering the significant amount of research being conducted in face recognition, it is imperative to thoroughly review some of the recent methods, enabling researchers and scientists to save time and effort. This paper attempts to pen down some contemporary face recognition algorithms based on deep learning by comprehensively reviewing various research publications from 2021 to 2023 in reputed journals. The article also lists the different datasets used in these papers to evaluate the performance of face recognition techniques.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Integrated Gradient based Self Refined Segment Editing parallel Model for Tracking Entities in Video Frames
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This work aims to develop an efficient and interpretable AI system that can accurately detect and monitor entities within restricted spaces, ensuring enhanced security and safety. The proposed model leverages the strength of explainable AI and applies the self-refined segment editing technique, allowing the model to better discern and track persons in complex environments, which enhances the model performance through iterative learning. Combining these two approaches allows the AI system to adapt to various scenarios and refine its tracking capabilities over time. The model is trained and evaluated in the experiment on a custom dataset comprising video frames from multiple restricted areas with posture and gait datasets. The results demonstrate that the hybrid model outperforms traditional tracking methods, exhibiting higher accuracy and interpretability. Additionally, the model's explainable nature provides insights into its decision-making process, enabling better understanding and trust in its output. The proposed hybrid Integrated Gradient with a self-refined segment editing model (IG-SEPM) holds promising potential for applications in security, surveillance, and safety measures in restricted areas. The metrics like mean Average Precision (mAP) (or) Intersection over Union (IoU) are used to measure the segment editing model's accuracy in tracking upon a standard sample. The comparative results show that the proposed model provides better results of about 89.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> Average precision value compared to other existing work. The output from SPEM shows that the model provides a target class predicted probability of 0.3 for α = 0.15. Then the valid masked image is interpreted in parallel using IG and obtains better target class predicted probability with average pixel gradients. The result shows that this proposed work gives better results than the existing system.

articleTitle: Rapid Peanut Dryer
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: A quick drying process for peanuts is very important to maintain the quality of the peanuts and to extend its shelf life. Conventional drying processes often involve extended drying times, resulting in decreased productivity, increased energy consumption and a higher risk of quality deterioration. These challenges significantly impact peanut farmers, processors and the overall peanut industry. In order to overcome these problems, the Rapid Peanut Dryer is designed with a closed loop system aimed at achieving efficient and accelerated peanut drying. The closed system performance evaluation focused on key parameters such as drying time and energy efficiency. The closed system significantly reduced drying time compared to traditional methods due to controlled air flow and optimized heat distribution. The combination of airflow and heat effectively promotes the evaporation of moisture from the peanuts, making them dry quickly. In addition, the use of industrial electric fans (DC 12V) and electric heaters has improved energy efficiency, minimizing energy consumption while maintaining optimal drying conditions during the entire drying process of the peanut. The success of the system is augmented by the utilization of an Arduino Uno microcontroller which is essential for switching the fan, heater, and motor via a relay (5v DC), thereby optimizing system control and efficiency. The designed closed system provides an efficient and effective solution for drying peanuts quickly. The system significantly reduces drying time by incorporating controlled airflow and temperature control while preserving peanut shell life and nutritional value. The system will contribute to the advancement in groundnut drying process by minimizing the power consumption and provide practical insights in reducing the peanut drying time.

articleTitle: Current Status and Challenges of Renewable Energy Implementation in Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper presents an updated assessment of the progress, challenges, and potential solutions for renewable energy-based power generation in Bangladesh. It emphasizes the growing consideration given to renewable energy sources as a practical substitute for fossil fuels in response to the country's rising energy needs and worries about climate change. The study analyses the policies and incentives in place to encourage the growth of renewable energy and looks at the country's progress to date in meeting its renewable energy goals. It also addresses the obstacles faced in adopting renewable energy, such as financing, technical capacity, and regulatory barriers, and explores potential solutions including appropriate financing mechanisms, effective regulatory frameworks, and grid integration. The final section of the paper discusses the prospects for renewable energy in Bangladesh, highlighting the possible advantages it could have for the country's economy, environment, and energy security.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Image Fusion Applied on Landsat-8 Archival Data Using UVCGAN
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Image fusion is required to maximise the utilisation of the different satellite sensors and enhance the usage and quality of the images obtained from them. One can get over obstacles like varied geographical resolutions, spectral bands, and temporal coverage by fusing images from multiple satellites, such as Landsat 8 and Sentinel 2. For various applications that involve observation of the Earth like land cover classification, monitoring of vegetation, disaster monitoring, and urban planning, the fusion process aims to produce composite images that integrate the spectral richness, spatial detail, and temporal frequency of the input images. The creation of Sentinel-like imagery from Landsat8 data enhances its potential for Earth observation applications, making the problem of Landsat 8 and Sentinel 2 imagery fusion very important to solve. A deep learning methodology is required to solve this problem because of its capacity to discover complex correlations and patterns within the data. In this paper, a U-Net Vision Transformer Cycle-consistent Generative Adversarial Network (UVCGAN) - based image fusion method that effectively transforms Landsat 8 images into Sentinel-like imagery is pro- posed. The results obtained from the experiments illustrate the efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed method in generating high-quality composite images with improved spectral and spatial characteristics.

articleTitle: Optimal Location of Facts Devices for Power Loss Reduction and Voltage Improvement in Deregulated Power System Using Rider Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: FACTS Devices enhance system loadability, making them the most effective congestion management strategies. Although FACTS controllers provide various advantages, their installation might be costly. The problem is initially described as a single-objective problem with the goals of maximizing branch loading, voltage stability, and loss. Increasing voltage stability, reducing power loss, and optimizing branch loading performance. Using a single-objective approach, the Rider optimization method was used to optimize the placement of the SVC and TCSC. The proposed method is evaluated and its outcomes are compared to those of the conventional genetic algorithm. The computation is done using the IEEE-30 bus technology in different test situations.

articleTitle: Electromechanical Analysis of DFIG under Winding Fault using Ansys Maxwell
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The paper discusses the broken winding fault in a doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG). The broken winding fault is one of the common faults that occur in a doubly-fed induction generator. The customary reason for the occurrence of this fault is due to manufacturing defects, overheating of the conducting wires, or short-circuiting of the wires in the stator or the rotor. This paper presents a Finite Element based analysis of the model as it offers more data on the functioning of the generator in a faulty situation. The finite element model for the healthy and faulty condition was created using the ANSYS Maxwell 2D software. The single-phase and two-phase winding fault is created in the healthy model and analyzed same. The paper includes various analyses like variations in torque and phase currents, losses, changes in flux lines, and effects on flux density. Finally, a comparison was carried out on the behavioural characteristics of the faulted generator with the healthy one. The main aim of this paper is to analyze the debilitating effects of the broken winding fault on the generator.

articleTitle: CAPTCHA Recognition Using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNN)
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper evaluates on captcha recognition using deep convolutional neural network. CAPTCHA is completely automated computer program which is used to publicly test and recognise human and robot separately. The captcha software builds very ambiguous pattern of alpha-numeric to protect the site being accessed by the robots, but these captchas maybe tough to crack by humans too. By using the deep learning model which can identify the captcha by studying the pattern of alphabets and numbers. This method can be further be used for handwriting recognition and number plate recognition. The major key feature in order to decipher the captcha was the pattern of the alphabet and the number, in the deep learning the convolution neural networks are the best to approach this. In convolutional neural network the feature maps help in identifying or recognizing the feature. To render the best outcome deep convolutional neural networks (DCNN) are used. As the deep CNN has many layers efficient and effective computation is done. A simple CNN can do the work but here the captcha has a very confusing forms which may not be effectively solved by the CNN alone. The convolutional operations performed on the sub matric of the picture of a captcha with the feature map matrix which has less index than the sub matric, the sub matric which accounts average convolutional value 1 is said to be the feature which is aimed to be recognized. As deep CNN has comparatively more layers it can compute the model deeply. This method helps the robots not identify the captchas and humans can use the deep learning models to solve it, and the robots are unaware of it. Hence, the DCNN method was the most efficient way to achieve the objective of CAPTCHA recognition with the required accuracy and minimal loss.

articleTitle: Simulation Case Studies on New Approaches to Energy Safeguarding: Empowering Remote Areas with Sustainable Power
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This research focuses on simulation studies that explore innovative approaches to energy conservation to empower remote areas through the implementation of sustainable power solutions. The objective is to address the energy needs of underserved regions that lack access to conventional power grids. By utilizing simulation techniques, this study aims to predict, analyze, and model various strategies for achieving the best and most cost-effective pathways of energy conservation and sustainable power generation in remote areas. This study assesses the performance, feasibility, and potential impact of each approach in terms of energy efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and environmental sustainability. The results of the simulation studies highlight the potential benefits of innovative energy conservation strategies in remote areas, including reduced energy costs, improved energy access, and enhanced socio-economic development. Furthermore, the research sheds light on the challenges and opportunities associated with the adoption and implementation of these approaches, guiding for overcoming barriers and maximizing the impact of sustainable power solutions.

articleTitle: Optimal Renewables-To-Grid Connection With N-1 Contingency Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The increasing global population has led to a significant rise in the demand for electricity. Traditionally, this demand has been met by conventional power sources such as fossil fuels. However, the environmental impact and limited availability of these sources have prompted the exploration of alternative energy options. Renewable energy sources, such as solar and biogas, have gained prominence due to their sustainability and lower carbon footprint. This paper focuses on the implementation of a hybrid system that integrates these renewable sources into the existing grid infrastructure. The objective is to create a reliable and stable energy system that reduces reliance on conventional generators and minimizes power loss. The performance of the hybrid system is evaluated through simulations, considering factors such as power loss and voltage profile. Additionally, the system undergoes N-1 contingency analysis to identify potential vulnerabilities and ensure its robustness. Mitigation measures are implemented to strengthen the system and address any identified weaknesses. The results demonstrate that the hybrid system effectively reduces electricity generation from conventional sources and minimizes power losses in the grid. Moreover, it is capable of meeting the growing load demand while maintaining stability and reliability. Overall, the integration of hybrid energy systems represents a promising solution for sustainable and resilient power generation.

articleTitle: GBMLP-RBM: A Novel Stacking Ensemble Learning Framework Using Retricted Boltzmann Machine and Gradient Boosting Algorithms for Heart Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Using a subset of The Behavioural Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) dataset, we develop a novel machine learning ensemble model to predict cardiovascular disease in this study. The ensemble method combines Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBM), Multilayer Perceptrons (MLP), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and Light Gradient Boosting Machines (LGBM) for the final selection. The RBM plays a crucial role in the initial transformation of features, with multiple layers creating a representation hierarchy. Using Synthetic Minority Oversampling, a Sequential model of RBMs followed by an MLP was trained and Integrated with an XGBoost model and employing a final LGBM selector resulted in an increase in accuracy to 94.53%. Compared to other methods such as Gradient boosting classifier and KNN classifiers, the proposed ensemble model demonstrated superior performance in terms of the studied metrics. The results indicate that this ensemble approach provides an efficient and effective method for predicting heart disease and could be expanded to predict other health-related risk behaviours. When coupled with a multi-layer perceptron, our model's performance is enhanced by gradient boosters and it outperforms competing models in almost all metrics. Additionally we perform anomaly detection on synthetic data using Variational Autoencoders.

articleTitle: Remote Vital-Sign Monitoring for Heart-Attack Patients in Telemedicine
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases have increased in the graph over the past few years worldwide. Annually, it is estimated that coronary heart disease (CHD) kills approximately 382,820 people in the world. According to statistics, in the year 2022 around 200 million people are living with coronary heart disease thus, prevention and detection of CVD are important. According to surveys, India will have more cardiac patients than any other nation by the year 2023. Thus, electrocardiograms, which are used to monitor the electrical activity of the heart, are more of a need than a pleasure. Remote vital sign monitoring systems have become a promising solution to detect and prevent heart attacks. This study proposes a health monitoring system that utilizes wearable devices to collect and analyze data on the vital signs of heart attack patients continuously. The system also incorporates machine-learning algorithms to analyze the data, identify patterns and anomalies, and generate real-time alerts for healthcare professionals in case of any abnormalities. The proposed system can be a valuable tool in preventing and detecting heart attacks and has the potential to revolutionize how healthcare professionals monitor and treat heart attack patients.

articleTitle: Optimizing Network Slicing Through Neural Network and Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Network slicing permits the development of several virtual networks on a shared physical architecture, allowing for the provision of varied communication services. To fully realize the benefits of network slicing, efficient resource allocation is critical. In this study, an artificial neural network (ANN) is utilized in conjunction with a heuristic technique known as particle swarm optimization (PSO) technology to determine the optimal process parameters for network slicing. The developed technique is instantiated by a two-way functionality that responds to various industrial demands. Typically, the operators are constrained by project specifications or time constraints in an industrial arrangement. As a result, a methodology that has been evaluated exclusively on specific real-time data with limited input parameters consists of three primary phases: (a) data gathering, (b) optimization of optimal weighted features, and (c) categorization of slicing. The established technique frees operators from imposing optimization parameters and allows them to provide the best solution for the goal. The model's validation reveals a strong fit between expected and experimental findings.

articleTitle: Peer-To-Peer Energy Trading Using MMR Mechanism in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This research work examines energy trading in microgrids by considering peer-to-peer mechanisms. Although microgrids may include energy trading between utilities and customers, their main objective is to provide dependable electricity in constrained geographical regions. Different energy resource owners sell electricity to one another via the practice of energy trading to increase financial earnings. This often plays a vital role in preserving the dependability of power networks and helping energy suppliers maximize their financial gains. Peer-to-peer (P2P) energy trading is a cutting-edge technique for managing an increasing number of Distributed Energy Resources in microgrids or local energy systems. Peer-to-peer (P2P) energy trading is the direct exchange of power and energy between consumers and prosumers. With the development of technology and the increasing use of renewable energy sources, among other factors, energy trading has emerged as a significant phenomenon in the international markets. To make this kind of trading more straightforward and enable energy producers to purchase and sell energy within a specified price range, mid-market strategies have been developed. In this work, which goes into great detail on the process, the benefits of the mid-market mechanism over alternative energy trading approaches are discussed It also looks at the difficulties that must be overcome in order for the mid-market mechanism to function as envisioned. From the result, it was noticed that the notion that this trading system would be beneficial to both producers and consumers.

articleTitle: Environment Safe Biodegradable Green RFID for Green Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) platform is becoming ubiquitous since its usage is mandatory in a smart environment. IoT solutions have greatly improvised the quality of life of mankind. Internet of Things is connected with high-performance devices that need more power to provide uninterruptable services. So, energy consumption is one of the essential parameters for IoT solutions. Hence, Green IoT emerged as a solution in minimizing energy utilization of IoT devices. Usage of the Internet and applications that run on IoT is inevitable in smart cities. Even though IoT has merit and a positive impact on human life, its usage produces toxic wastes. Such an alarming constraint raised the concern for protecting the environment's nature as well as the smart cities. To mitigate the harmfulness of IoT, finding an alternate solution is mandatory, thus Green IoT has come into the picture. Green IoT is the trend with a lot of future scope for creating eco-friendly smart solutions. To minimize the toxic wastes lot of efforts are needed to reduce carbon footprint. The application of RFID in IoT smart environment is manifold. This paper proposed novel eco-friendly RFID tags. The proposed tags are designed with a water repellent to make it an eco-friendly and bio-degradable one. Moreover, this paper discusses the importance of Green IoT along with an insight into reducing carbon footprint while designing IoT devices.

articleTitle: Enhancing Energy Efficiency in Residential Buildings: A Comparative Analysis of Supervised and Unsupervised Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper different machine learning algorithms are used to predict the energy performance of residential buildings. Prediction of energy consumption has a major role in energy conservation, management, and planning. The data is classified using a variety of supervised and unsupervised techniques. For generating predictive models, predictive modelling algorithms are employed for regression as well as classification. It is examined to determine how well the various predictive models perform and contrast with each other. A comparative analysis was implemented to assess the surmising performance of the model.
