The system model has been simulated in MATLAB/SIMULINK software to validate the performance of the proposed bidirectional DC-DC converter. Moreover, a PI controller has been incorporated for controlling the DC link voltage so that the input voltage for the motor controller is maintained. A simple three-phase inverter powered the motor with the help of Hall sensor signals to generate the gate pulses and the findings are reported well at the end with the concluding remarks.

articleTitle: Intelligent Path Planning and Machine Learning Integration for Autonomous Firefighting Robots: A Novel Approach for Efficient Fire Suppression
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The fire-fighting robot is specifically designed to operate in high-risk environments, such as factories or chemical plants, where fires can occur. Its primary goal is to detect and extinguish fires effectively while minimizing the risk to human lives. Equipped with advanced technology, the robot features three flame sensors and a controller for detecting fires in its immediate surroundings. With a robust chassis housing four motors and wheels, it can maneuver through tight spaces with ease. The robot's arsenal includes a servo motor, L293D motor driver module, mini DC submersible pump, and a small breadboard for precise control. To suppress the fire, it carries a container for water or other extinguishing agents. Additionally, it is integrated with an HP W-200 web cam module, enabling remote monitoring of the fire's intensity and the presence of humans in the vicinity. The robot effectively clears a path by extinguishing the fire ahead and displays a path, making it safe for fire-fighters to reach and rescue any potential victims.

articleTitle: Single-Tuned Harmonic Passive Filter Design for AC Electric Railway Traction Power Substation
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper focuses on the design of single-tuned passive harmonic filters to mitigate harmonics found in the load current of an AC railway system. This system is modelled in MATLAB/Simulink as a 50Hz 25kV TPSS connected to an ETS train which acts as the load. The train's load profile is generated based on an energy consumption model which simulates the train stopping at a station and then departing. FFT analysis is performed on the load current to determine the harmonic magnitudes while at the same time the THD and TDD of the load current is calculated. The simulation results show that all these values exceed the threshold values set by the standard IEEE-519. Therefore, single-tuned passive harmonic filters are designed each for the 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, and 11th harmonic to mitigate the respective harmonic at a low cost. These filter's reactive power and quality factor are used to determine the filter's RLC parameters. The Bode plot of each filter is also generated and analyzed. After the filters are added to the model, results show that all harmonic magnitudes are reduced to less than 4% whereas TDD is reduced to less than 5%, which successfully meets below the limit set by IEEE-519.

articleTitle: Enhanced Non-Isolated Dc-Dc Converter with Common Ground for Renewable Energy Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The paper discusses a non-isolated quadratic DC-DC boost converter with high gain, which is applicable in areas demanding high voltage gain. With the advantage of Voltage Multiplier Cell (VMC), a much higher voltage gain at low duty cycle is achieved as compared to the conventional boost converter. Furthermore, reduced voltage stresses across diodes, capacitors and switches have enhanced the efficiency of the proposed topology. The steady-state analysis, designing methodologies, and a detailed comparison with the similar topologies are presented in this paper. The model was simulated using PLECS software. A very negligible variance among the experimental, theoretical, and simulated results were experienced.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques of Land Use and Land Cover Classification Using Google Earth Engine: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: To manage assets sustainably and to comprehend how the landscape is changing due to climate change and the passage of time, it is essential to classify LULC accurately. Reliable classification techniques and excellent datasets are necessary for accurate and effective LULC classification. The performance of different satellite data and classification method combinations must be objectively evaluated in order to choose the most effective method for LULC classification given the increasing accessibility of satellite data, geospatial analysis tools, and classification algorithms. This study uses a case study for the Machilipatnam region utilizing two distinct years that 2017 and 2022 to evaluate the LULC classification performance of the widely used platform (i.e., Google Earth Engine) with multiple satellite datasets (i.e., Landsat, Sentinel). This will make it simpler to select the most efficient LULC categorization technique. In contrast, Google Earth Engine creates LULC maps for the various time periods using SVM, classification and regression tree (CART), and Naive Bayes as its three classifiers. The total accuracy of each classifier is computed during the investigation for all conceivable pairings of satellite data, classification platforms, and procedures to determine how well the classifiers are performing. Findings indicate that the SVM classifier is superior to the other two classifiers for the two years 2017 and 2022. Particularly, in the year 2017, the SVM exhibits an overall accuracy of 0.85, CART exhibits an accuracy of 0.73, and Naive Bayes exhibits an accuracy of 0.57. Similarly, in the year 2022, SVM classifier has the highest accuracy (0.78), followed by CART with 0.71 and Naive Bayes with 0.57.

articleTitle: Solar-Wind Fed EV Charger at Variable Irradiance and Wind Speeds
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: To meet the growing demand of transportation the fast depleting conventional sources and fossil fuel supplies are being exhausted. A cheap and environmentally friendly replacement for conventional power sources is renewable solar and wind power. Solar and wind energy in combination is always accessible and is preferable in applications that require continuous power. A small solar-wind energy facility would be suitable for EV charging applications. In this paper a charger for Electric Vehicle is proposed using Solar-Wind hybrid source. Maximum power point tracking is used in both the solar and wind systems separately. The sources are combined in complimentary mode and is given to a battery. The model is studied at various combinations of irradiances and wind speeds.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Compatibility: Challenges, Solutions, and Best Practices for Mitigating EMI in Electronic Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) and Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) are critical aspects in the field of electronics and electrical engineering, gaining increasing importance as technology continues to advance. This research paper aims to shed light on the design of power supply systems that are EMI/EMC compatible. It explores the optimization of components and methodologies employed in electronic systems to be used for mitigation. We also present an examination of impact of EMI and EMC on overall performance and reliability of the power supply. These concepts are illustrated through a case study.

articleTitle: Real-Time Transient Instability Identification in Power Systems USING a PMU-Based EMS System
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Modern power systems are confronted with operational challenges that increase the risk of transient instability. Existing Dynamic Security Assessment (DSA) tools have limitations, necessitating accurate and timely assessment of transient stability. To address this, a novel approach for real-time identification of transient instability is introduced in this paper using a Thevenin equivalent network model. The proposed method leverages synchronized phasor measurements and incorporates PMU-based Energy Management System (EMS) with Linear State Estimation (LSE) alongside snapshots from existing EMS systems, cascading analysis application, and a performance index (PI) to rank cascading outages based on severity. A case study demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed method to identify transient instabilities in a large interconnected power system through real-time hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulations. By offering enhanced accuracy and efficiency in real-time stability assessment, the method empowers grid operators to promptly act and prevent wide area outages during challenging operating conditions. Future research directions encompass integration with Wide-Area Monitoring, Protection, and Control (WAMPAC) system, incorporation of advanced machine learning techniques alongside data analytics, as well as scalability examination across diverse operating conditions and contingencies.

articleTitle: System for Supporting Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder Based on Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Deep Learning Techniques aim to develop a web application that displays and also alert the data from electromyography (EMG) for remote analysis and control. EMG is a method for capturing the electrical activity of muscles that has many uses in the medical sector, sports science and other areas. However the process of collecting, storing and analyzing EMG data can be complex and time-consuming particularly when it involves multiple patients or remote locations. To address these challenges, our project leverages biometrics software to convert graphical data from EMG to digital format which can then be stored in the cloud using Deep Learning Techniques and accessed remotely. Deep Learning Techniques provides a user-friendly interface for accessing and analyzing this data enabling healthcare professionals and researchers to make informed decisions based on real-time data. The project involved several key steps including designing and implementing the software architecture which collects EMG data from test subjects, analyzing the data using biometrics software and developing the web application for remote access and analysis by using deep learning techniques.

articleTitle: Development of Eco-Friendly Solar PV Based DC-DC Triple Lift Luo Power Converter for Water Pumping Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The dependence on renewable energy sources has grown as a result of the necessity for an alternative energy source. Solar PV panels are one of the most environmentally friendly and economically viable renewable energy sources currently available. For the purpose of connecting the PV and the BLDC motor for water pumping, an appropriate interfacing circuit is required. The objective of the paper is to design and analyze a novel positive output triple lift split capacitor type Luo DC-DC converter for PV water pumping applications. Positive output converters are used to increase the voltage gain in geometric progression. These converters are employed as front-end converters as the output of a single PV cell is about 0.6V only. The proposed triple lift Luo converter is studied, analyzed and investigated. Simulation of the DC-DC converter is performed in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The functioning factors of the Luo converter such as voltage gain, ripple and voltage stress are computed and compared with the classical boost converter. A laboratory model is built to validate the simulation results. From the results, it is observed that the Luo converter outperforms as a suitable converter for PV. The results are analyzed.

articleTitle: Extended Kalman-Bucy Filter with Fuzzy Hybrid Model for State of Charge Estimation of Lithium-Ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In recent decades, the number of electric vehicles (EVs) on the road has skyrocketed. Electric vehicles have electric motors instead of internal combustion engines, and a battery powers the electric motor. Battery charging and discharging determine the maximum number of issues in EVS. State of charge (SOC) is a battery parameter that controls the charging and discharging of the battery. The precise estimation of SOC is more complicated. This article focused on accurately estimating SOC using a hybrid model with an Extended Kalman-Bucy filter and fuzzy logic controller (EKBF- FC). The proposed topology was implemented in the 2RC equivalent circuit model of the lithiumion battery Panasonic NCR18650PF. Using MATLAB Simscape tools, the proposed topology was modelled, and its operational characteristics were analysed. The proposed topology's SOC estimation has a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.49% and a root mean square error (RMSR) of 0.72%, significantly less than the current SOC estimation methods. A comparative analysis reveals that the proposed method is the most appropriate for real-time SOC estimation for EV applications.

articleTitle: Back Flashover Performance of 500 kV Double Circuit Transmission Lines Struck by Lightning
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Effective electricity transmission system is critical to the power system stability at the consumer ends. To ensure an uninterruptible supply, the insulation of the transmission lines must be evaluated and coordinated. Research has shown that lightning contributes the largest percentage of outages in tropical countries. This work presents an Electromagnetic Transient Program (EMTP)-based back flashover performance evaluation for 500 kV double circuit transmission lines during lightning events in Malaysia. The main parameters considered are the resistance of the tower footing and lightning current waveshapes and magnitudes. The results found that those parameters influence the reliability of the transmission system during lightning incidence. Hence, the need to devise an adequate protection system is necessary. The findings from this work are useful to electrical utilities for identifying root causes of the transmission lines back flashover occurrence.

articleTitle: Spiking Neural Network-Based Digit Pattern Recognition in FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The scientific community has major challenges in understanding how the brain works and recreating it in various forms, whether biological or computer. There is strong evidence that such a feat could be accomplished, given that we ourselves are an example of an intelligent system, even though time travel and faster-than-light travel remain unattainable goals. It may be possible to develop a system capable of awareness and responsive interaction with the outside world by mimicking brain function. The fundamental goal of this work is to build a digital system that can mimic the behavior of spiking neural networks on a single chip. It attempts to carry out mental processes including reasoning, speech recognition, movement, and visual processing. The system is described using VHDL, a high-level hardware description language, to create a compromise between simplicity, efficiency, and performance without sacrificing the precision necessary for simulating neural networks.

articleTitle: Estimating Remaining Useful Life and State of Health of EV Lithium Ion Batteries Using Sequential CNNs
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries power electric cars, portable electronics, and renewable energy systems. To ensure these batteries' optimal performance, avoid unexpected failures, and reduce maintenance costs, their usable life must be accurately predicted. This study examines data-driven, physics-based, and hybrid methods for calculating lithium-ion battery life. The proposed work also offers a unique way to estimate lithium-ion battery usable life using machine learning. This method uses current, voltage and temperature to build a prediction model that accurately predicts the battery's remaining usable life. An archive of lithium-ion battery cycles is used to evaluate the proposed strategy and compare it to other cutting-edge methods. The results support the proposed lithium-ion battery lifespan strategy. The precise estimation of battery SOH ensures uninterrupted operation and prevents unexpected battery failures, improving electric vehicle reliability and safety. It also optimizes battery use, extending battery life and lowering replacement costs. The proposed method could improve electric vehicle (EV) performance and efficacy using machine learning and electrochemical modeling, promoting sustainable transportation. Portable electric machines, electric locomotives, and renewable energy storage systems use lithium-ion batteries. For optimal performance, cost reduction, and preventing unexpected failures, accurate SOH estimation is essential. This paper examines data-driven, physics-based, and hybrid SOH estimation methods. This paper proposes a machine learning-based SOH prediction method that uses battery performance parameters like voltage, current, and temperature. The proposed work shows that this method outperforms state-of-the-art methods on a battery cycle dataset. EV reliability, safety, and battery utilization improve with accurate SOH estimation, lowering replacement costs. The proposed method can improve EV performance and promote sustainable transportation by using machine learning and electrochemical modeling.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Colon Cancer using Fine Tuned Light Weight CNN Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: There are around 1.8 million new cases of colorectal cancer diagnosed every year, making it one of the most prevalent forms of the disease. Therefore, the infection and mortality rates can be reduced with early identification of this cancer. Most diagnostic colonoscopy systems are currently incorporating artificial intelligence approaches validated for predicting advanced cancers. It is common practice to combine convolutional neural network-based patterns with image patches and preprocesses. The purpose of this paper was to develop a novel lightweight deep learning Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) that uses Adam optimizer for reliable colon cancer detection. Applying a database of publicly available histopathology images, the proposed approach is analyzed in the context of the existing best practices for colon cancer detection analysis. Based on the results, it is clear that the proposed deep neural network for colon cancer diagnosis achieves an accuracy of 98.40 percent, which is the highest accuracy achieved by any of the existing deep learning methods.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Isolated Interleaved Boost Converter and Full Bridge Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Distributed generation and cell power systems often necessitate the use of high step-up DC-DC converters. In solar Photovoltaic generation systems, the output produced by the solar panel will be low DC voltage which should be boosted to high voltage to be used for other applications. Here, a high voltage gain DC-DC converter become a key component between the solar panel and the high voltage DC bus.Isolated DC-DC converters are widely utilized in practical systems due to their ability to achieve high voltage gain and provide galvanic isolation. There are many DC-DC converter topologies available but selecting the most appropriate converter for PV application is important. The paper proposes a comparative study of the two most efficient DC-DC converters which are the Full bridge converter and Isolated interleaved boost converter. These topologies are analyzed in detail and the selection of a well-suited converter for photovoltaic applications with Low-cost, compact, highly efficient, and low-noise characteristics is done based on a comparative study.

articleTitle: Design of IPMSM using FEA in Ansys Maxwell
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The performance of an EV (Electric Vehicle) is heavily dependent on the electric motor; hence its design is crucial. This paper presents the design and analysis of 4Kw V-type IPMSM by Finite Element Analysis using Ansys Maxwell 2D software. Analytical design is carried out to determine the various parameters of motor used in modelling and analysis. A 36 slots and 6 poles slot-pole combination is selected with rated speed of 1800rpm. Various simulation results such as magnetic loading curves, back emf wave forms, torque-speed characteristics, etc. have been analyzed in detail. MATLAB is used to obtain the torque-speed characteristics. Final comparison of analytical and simulation results show that the design is accurate and is meeting the technical specifications of IPMSM.

articleTitle: A Novel Self Learning Activation Function Using Gegenbauer Polynomials for An Effective Medical Image Denoising
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In medical image analysis denoising of an image is a salient preprocessing step. A large number of methods are proposed for image denoising with varying performance. In this research article, we present an innovative sparse-aware autoencoder model designed for effectively denoising images in non-Gaussian noise environments. The proposed model uses a self learning Gegenbauer polynomials based activation function. The performance of proposed model is verified on X-ray and CT scan images under various noise levels and observed its superiority over existing methods.

articleTitle: IoT Based Energy Management System in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper provides an overview of IoT-based energy management applications in smart grids. The deployment of IoT-based smart energy management in a smart grid has the potential to revolutionize the energy sector. Utilities can optimize energy use, balance the grid, incorporate renewable resources, improve dependability, and empower consumers to actively participate in energy management by harnessing the power of data, connection, and automation. As technology advances and IoT infrastructure becomes more pervasive, the benefits of smart energy management in the smart grid are anticipated to expand, resulting in a more sustainable, efficient, and resilient energy future.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Forecasting Solar Photovoltaic Power Generation Using Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Solar PV power generation is intermittent and results in various grid related issues when integrated to the utility grid. By having prior knowledge of the power generation capabilities of solar photovoltaic (PV) systems, it becomes possible to execute the operation of other power systems in a systematic manner, thereby mitigating grid-related issues arising from the intermittent nature of solar PV power generation. This paper discusses PV power forecasting using Artificial Neural Networks by two different approaches. The results obtained from the selected approaches are presented and discussed. The performance evaluation of the selected methods is carried out in terms of root mean square error (RMSE), mean absolute error (MAE) and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> values.

articleTitle: Hybrid Face and Eye Gesture Tracking Algorithm for Tello EDU RoboMaster TT Quadrotor Drone
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Controlling a drone requires accuracy and efficiency, especially regarding gesture recognition. It's crucial to ensure that these gestures are mapped correctly and that the recognition algorithms are safe and computationally efficient. To achieve this, a hybrid gesture recognition module is developed in this paper using machine learning techniques, such as MediaPipe, OpenCV, and djitellopy packages, and frameworks in a Python language environment. The module can precisely identify and categorize specified movements from a live video feed, creating a mapping between gesture movements and drone actions. The goal is to assess the gesture tracking and control system on the Tello EDU drone platform, which has limited hardware resources. The results show that the algorithm is effective in an indoor environment, allowing users to enjoy the benefits of gesture recognition without worrying about unintended or dangerous actions by the drone.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of SPS and DPS Controlled DAB-Based DC-DC Converter for EV Charging
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Inadequate charging infrastructure and the unavailability of fast chargers are significant hurdles in the rapid adoption of EVs. Several attempts have been made to develop EV chargers with features such as a high power density, low weight, low cost, and compact size. One of the popular converter topologies for high-power applications is the dual active bridge (DAB), owing to its inherent characteristics such as high efficiency, bidirectional power flow capability, galvanic isolation, and low number of passive components. DAB converters are being used in a wide variety of applications. Many control techniques have been proposed for this type of converter. In this study, a PI controller-based closed-loop DAB model of DAB for two control techniques: single phase shift (SPS) modulation and dual phase shift (DPS) modulation in the MATLAB/Simulink environment. The results of both control techniques are compared, and a conclusion is made regarding their suitability for EV charging.

articleTitle: Parameter Optimization of Three Branch Supercapacitor Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Supercapacitors have gained significant attention for their exceptional power density and fast charge/discharge capabilities. To fully exploit their potential, optimizing the parameters of the three-branch model is crucial. This research focuses on developing an optimization approach using Gradient Descent method with Sequential Quadratic Programming (SQP) algorithm to determine the optimal parameter values for the 470-F double-layer capacitor. The integration of Gradient Descent with SQP enhances the optimization process, ensuring parameters are fine-tuned within given constraints. The objective is to enhance the performance and efficiency of the three-branch supercapacitor model for various applications. By optimizing the parameters, improvements in power density, energy storage capacity, and overall performance are anticipated. This optimized model can be seamlessly integrated into portable electronics and renewable energy systems, meeting the demand for advanced energy storage solutions. This research contributes to the advancement of supercapacitor technology and facilitates its effective deployment across domains.

articleTitle: Intelligent Safety Braking System for High Speed Vehicle on Curved Road for Rollover Prevention
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Rollover incidents are a major factor in road accidents worldwide especially when traversing curved roads at high speeds. Such accidents often result in serious injuries to the passengers as well as damages to the vehicle, making them a cause of serious concern for automobile manufacturers. The lateral acceleration and complex dynamics such as aerodynamics, suspension involved in such maneuver can lead to loss of control over vehicle and tires losing ground contact leading to rollover incident. The lateral forces such as centrifugal force generated in such maneuvers are related to vehicle velocity. When vehicle velocity exceeds critical velocity for particular curvature, the car will rollover jeopardizing the safety of occupants as well as other road users. The drivers may not be able to correctly predict the critical velocity for curvature. Therefore there is need of intelligent braking system which will aid the driver by reducing the speed and keeping it below critical value to mitigate the risk of rollover accidents. This research proposes a fuzzy logic based intelligent braking system which utilizes fuzzy logic controller that takes into account the vehicle speed and road curvature. The proposed fuzzy logic based controller has been validated in SimuLink Environment. Various curved roads scenarios were simulated and the controller was able to keep the vehicle speed below threshold. The findings demonstrate that the system effectively maintains vehicle speed according to the curvature. The results validate the efficacy of proposed system in mitigating rollover risk and enhancing vehicle safety on curved roads.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Last-Mile Delivery: Unleashing Unprecedented Efficiency in Package Logistics
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The pivotal role of efficient delivery processes in the success of e-commerce enterprises necessitates a comprehensive examination of optimized delivery routes. This paper introduces an innovative software solution to revolutionize delivery agents' performance by implementing streamlined routing strategies. This research study endeavors to redefine and optimize the landscape of delivery processes for e-commerce enterprises by introducing an advanced routing optimization solution. This study uses the renowned traveling salesman's algorithm to develop a sophisticated software application that empowers delivery agents to maximize operational efficiency. The findings of this study underscore the substantial advantages offered by the software solution. The optimized routes generated by the algorithm demonstrate significant reductions in delivery time and distance, thereby enhancing operational efficiency for e-commerce enterprises.

articleTitle: Programmable Wireless Adapter for Commercial Electric Drives and Multifunction Meters
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Continuous monitoring of power consumption data obtained from energy meters and drives installed in commercial and industrial applications is crucial for the efficient utilization of electrical energy as well as assessing the equipment's health. Though all relevant parameters are acquired in energy meters and electrical drives, they are not continuously monitored and stored for further analysis. To address this issue, we have developed a low-cost IOT-enabled programmable adapter to collect and transmit data to the cloud or on-premises server. Most commercial multifunction meters and drives are integrated with a standard Modbus RS-485 physical layer interface for data communication. The ESP32- WROOM microcontroller is used to interface with Modbus Remote Terminal Units (RTU) for the retrieval of data periodically. For validation, real-time data is collected from a chiller plant integrated with MFM384 multifunction meters and Danfoss drives. To visualize and store the data for further analysis, a flutter-based open application is developed for the users of the proposed hardware.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of a Polymer Based Antenna for Cognitive Radio Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Microstrip patch antennas are popular due to their appealing characteristics such as low profile, light weight, low cost, ease of fabrication, and integration with RF devices. A narrowband, wide-beam antenna known as a microstrip or patches are created by etching the antenna element pattern in the metal traces that are adhered to insulating dielectric substrates. Most commonly used dielectric substrate is FR4, which has good mechanical and electrical properties but, it possesses very low thermal conductivity. At very low temperature, it becomes less flexible and rigid. Novel polymer substrate materials are proposed to design the patch antennas for cognitive radio applications in S band frequency. Polyethylene based patch antennas are designed using HFSS in three most popular shapes such as rectangular, circular and triangular. The triangular patch with polyethylene substrate achieves the maximum gain with a value of 7.46dB and a maximum directivity of 7.6dB, which is twice the gain from the ordinary FR4 substrate. Proposed materials are more flexible and has shown improvement in terms of gain, directivity and return loss. Further design optimization may be needed to reduce VSWR.

articleTitle: Artificial Pancreas Blood Glucose-Insulin Regularization System Using PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The purpose of this work is to design of an artificial pancreas for precise blood glucose insulin regularization for a diabetes patient. The author proposed a continuous Glucose monitoring system. Where Insulin will be injected externally into the patient using an insulin pump known as the artificial pancreas. Bergman's simple model is used in a closed-loop system that employs a PID controller and MATLAB/SIMULINK. This regularization system determines the required amount of external Insulin infusion through the control actions involved according to the meal disorders and other factors involved. The artificial pancreas simulation model includes a continuous glucose monitor, an insulin injection pump, and a potential PID controller. This study uses a combinational mathematical model to provide a simple glucose-insulin monitoring and regularisation method for type 1 diabetes patients. The findings of the SIMULINK simulation have demonstrated that when the intake of glucose during meals is balanced, the body's insulin sensitivity can be stabilized and the hypoglycemia condition effectively regulated. The results show that this model is reliable and useful, and it may be utilized to lay out information for research on blood glucose regulation.

articleTitle: A Novel Proposal in Multilevel Inverter with Genetic Algorithm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In transformation of resources like power the multilevel inverters are the best technology. Output as stair waveform signal feed as input to many of the DC sources. The description of multilevel inverter topology is described in the paper. The presentation consist of 7 level architecture principle and to obtain best quality of output signal the algorithm of adaptive genetic is adopted to slow down the harmonic content. In actual time the evaluations of appropriate switching angle used to analyse the THD minimization. The overall observations are declined based on 7 level to cases in other levels and THD determination in various states. These studies are based on MATLAB simulation and programming. The proposed work is simulated using MATLAB software which gives the model accuracy rate of 80% with the lesser error rate. The multilevel inverter designed using the proposed method removes the harmonic function at various input voltage with the minimum loss factors.

articleTitle: Driving Range Estimation Using AMRIT for Prognostics Model of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: State of charge (SoC) and discharging estimations are evolving techniques in electric vehicles. These two factors influence the thermal model and driving-range estimation logic efficiency and accuracy. Even though many research ideas have been presented with various data science principles and deep learning algorithms, sustainable embedded EV product realization has been the biggest challenge in the automotive industry during the last decade. In this study, Alternative Machine Reasoning and Integrative Techniques (AMRIT) were adapted to estimate battery discharge behavior and driving range estimation. The remaining driving range is a crucial metric as defined in the Indian regulation standard (AIS-040). Python simulations has been presented to compare the energy consumption, thermal model of the battery, and discharge pattern to deliver a consistent driving range in the dashboard for driver assistance.

articleTitle: Chipless RFID Tag by V-shaped Multi-resonator for Partial Discharge-affected Equipment Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Partial discharge (PD) in insulating materials is a threatening phenomenon for high voltage (HV) equipment. In PD diagnostics, chipless RFID (CRFID) tags have been rarely used despite their recent popularity in so many other sensing applications. So far, only a handful of works have been attempted where CRFID tags are applied to detect PD signals and identify the PD-affected equipment. However, due to the incompatible integration and complicated design of CRFID tags, those attempts have failed to solve the issue of early PD detection while identifying the HV equipment. In this paper, we propose a new CRFID tag that offers a compatible system integration and simple design for the application of early PD detection and HV equipment identification. The proposed tag is designed by using V-shaped multi-resonators on a one-eighth- wave transmission line that is reciprocally bent by a V-shape. With a compact area of 16 × 15 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, the tag is designed to separately exhibit a low-pass response in the ultra-high frequency (UHF) range for PD detection and a multi-resonating response within 2.86−5.27 GHz frequencies for HV equipment identification purposes. Our designed tag offers an encoding capacity of 12 bits, a high bit density of 5 bits/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and a spectral density of 4.98 bits/GHz. We expect the proposed tag will bring a promising solution to overcome the integration complexity of CRFID tags in UHF sensor-based PD sensing applications.

articleTitle: Design Prospects of Parallel U-Shaped Multi-Resonator for Fabric-Based Chipless RFID Tags
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper introduces a new 10-bit planar parallel U-shaped multi-resonator (PUMR) that is designed specifically for retransmission-based chipless radio frequency identification (CRFID) applications, with the aim of enabling its integration into fabric-based CRFID systems. The PUMR functions within the ultra-wide band (UWB) frequency spectrum. Simulation of the PUMR was carried out on two distinct PCB types, namely Rogers 3003 and Rogers 5880, as well as five different fabric-based substrates: pile, denim, silk, felt, and fleece. The results reveal a good spectral density (bits/GHz) of up to 4.7 bits/GHz was achieved using the Rogers 5880 substrate within a bandwidth of 2.13 GHz. Also, the design displays a good spatial density of ∼ 11 bit/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The PUMR design exhibits a coding capacity of up to 10 bits. The effectiveness of the proposed design was demonstrated by employing various extracted bit streams, such as 1111111111, 0000000000, 0101010101, 1010101010, and 0101000101. Additionally, a bending analysis was conducted to assess the suitability of the design on fabric. These findings showcase the efficiency of the proposed PUMR design and provide an incentive for CRFID designers to develop compact, high-capacity tags in UWB range.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Performance of Sensing Elements Using Mechanically Exfoliated MoS2 Nanosheet
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this study, MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> Nanosheets were synthesised by the mechanical exfoliation technique. The prepared MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> nanosheets were characterised by X-Ray Diffraction (XRD), Fourier Transform Infra-Red Spectrophotometer (FTIR), UV-Visible Spectroscopy, Atomic Force Microscope (AFM), Optical microscope, and Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscope (FE-SEM). The experimental results indicate significant effects on the surface roughness of the prepared MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> nanosheets. Resistance and sheet resistivity measured over the MoS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> nanosheet using a 4-probe semiconductor parameter analyzer gives a prominent result that is suitable for piezoresistive, flexible, and optoelectronic applications.

articleTitle: Real-time ECG Analysis and Classification using Neural Networks in IoT devices
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper develops a simple, cost-efficient, and easy-to-access ECG analyzer. The proposed prototype can perform the acquisition of ECG Signals lively from the subject, and display ECG Signals in real-time through IoT devices such as mobiles. The work diagnoses such as classifying the subject to having Arrhythmia, Congestive Heart Failure and Normal Sinus Rhythm. The prototype is to be equipped with a pre-trained Deep Learning model, which helps in the classification of ECG signals obtained from the subject, thus helping in providing a quick and basic insight into the would-be medical care needed by the subject. The prototype is to be equipped with a pre-trained Deep Learning model, which helps in the classification of ECG signals obtained from the subject, thus helping in providing a quick and basic insight into the would-be medical care needed by the subject.

articleTitle: Modified Time-Domain Features for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Bearing Fault Detection Using Current Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: A new modified time domain features are proposed namely, average energy, absolute value of summation of square root, log detector, modified mean absolute value, and absolute value of summation of exponential root to classify the bearing fault through phase current signal as well as vibration signal using support vector machine (SVM), k-nearest neighbor (k-NN), and linear discriminant analysis classifiers for four different operating conditions in eight derived datasets. In this work, the proposed modified time-domain features are experimentally investigated using Paderborn University bearing database with healthy, outer race and inner race faults. Finally, the paper concludes, the current signal based fault classification accuracies performs better in comparison with vibration signal under individual operating conditions for all possible 31 feature ensembles. The classification accuracies of modified time-domain feature yields up to 100% on five different bearing conditions with SVM and k-NN classifiers using motor current signal under operating condition-1. The proposed features shows that not only good accuracy using motor current signal, but also have less computation time.

articleTitle: An Overview of Electrically Coupled Multi-Input DC-DC Converters for Hybrid Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The modern evolution of electrically coupled multi-input dc-dc converters is pointed out and scrutinized in this paper. Initially, a few dc-dc converters are connected in parallel to form a multi-input converter. But currently, a few modern structures have been suggested for this purpose. So, they are used in hybrid electric vehicles and renewable energy systems. Three groups of multi-input converters are electrically coupled, magnetically coupled, and electro-magnetically coupled converters. This paper deals with electrically coupled dc-dc converters because of their advantages, like no need for a transformer, not requiring physical isolation between input and output, smaller and lighter, etc.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for an Assembly Line Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Online inspection of moving objects and count is an ongoing interest to industry. This paper has taken up a study of inspection and counting of processing products on a conveyor using MATLAB and their toolboxes. This model is aimed to ease inventory management, obtain manufacturing data on large-scale productions and automate the manual process of counting and inspection in an industrial environment to overcome time and cost constraints. The model works by initially pre-processing the video input file and then using image processing algorithms to identify the moving objects within the video frame. The identified moving objects are labelled with numbers and bounding boxes. After feature extraction the model is trained to inspect the objects with a sufficient dataset. Once training and testing are completed, the model can be used to inspect objects for faults and defects. This model can be used as a solution to automate manual processes in an assembly plant.

articleTitle: Performance Investigation on BLDC Motor and Regenerative Braking with Super-Capacitor for Electric Vehicle Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this modern world, electric vehicles are very popularly growing day-to-day. In these electric vehicles, the parameter estimation and sizing of the appropriate motor and braking system controller design need a lot of implementations. Brushless-DC (BLDC) motors are very popular in improving efficiency at high and low costs. Further, it utilizes state-of-the-art super-capacitor technology to enhance the efficiency of electric vehicles. A powertrain is a crucial element that consists of a battery inverter, braking controller, and charging port. Also useful for further researching components of powertrain and various parts of electric vehicles. This research delves into a comparative analysis of various motor efficiency and power-to-weight ratios. An optimized regenerative braking control system harnesses the energy storage system with the functioning of a generator. The performance of the model was tested in a Matlab/Simulink environment. This research aims to enhance the regulation of energy power flow in electric vehicles, ultimately, regenerative efficiency maximized.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Fast Terminal Sliding Mode and ADRC Fusion Control for Quadcopter UAVs
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This research addresses the complexities through the development of an innovative control strategy that merges adaptive Fast Terminal Sliding Mode Control with linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control (AFTSMC-ADRC). To enhance UAV performance in the presence of external disturbances and model uncertainties, an adaptive convergence law is formulated. The control methodology entails the design of a rapid terminal sliding mode surface to facilitate global fast convergence, coupled with adaptive combination laws to amplify state convergence speed and robustness against disturbances. The efficacy of the proposed controller is empirically substantiated through practical flight experiments and simulation tests, revealing notable improvements in UAV tracking precision and resilience compared to conventional cascaded PID algorithms.

articleTitle: Design and Modeling of Inductive Wireless Power Transfer for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Due to the increasing issue of global warming and climate change, electric vehicle(EV) penetration in the automobile market has increased exponentially. Infrastructure and charging technology must also be created to enable the adoption of EVs and meet their charging needs. This paper proposes a simulation model for Wireless Power Transfer(WPT) using the Inductive WPT method for the transmission of power while using the induction of voltage between the transmitter and receiver. The proposed system introduces a low-cost and flexible method that provides new benefits over conventional methods of power transmission.

articleTitle: Shockable Arrhythmia Detection Using Sequential Minimal Optimization, and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Ventricular arrhythmias (VAs) are potentially fatal arrhythmias and the primary cause of sudden cardiac arrest (SCA). To prevent SCA, immediate treatment is defibrillation using automatic external devices (AEDs). The electrocardiogram (ECG) signal's minute fluctuations in amplitude, duration, and shape make it difficult to categorize VAs from other types of arrhythmias. In this work, we implemented a nonlinear feature extraction-based approach to detect VAs. After the filtering and segmentation (8 seconds and 5 seconds) process, the ECG signals are decomposed using empirical mode decomposition (EMD). A new feature set is extracted from the decomposed intermediate mode functions (IMFs). The obtained features from the IMFs are fed to the support vector machine (SVM) classifier with a sequential minimal optimizer (SMO). We deployed the PhysioNet ECG databases to assess the model. We compare the proposed method to current practices using the performance metric provided by the average accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity values. Average accuracy levels increased on 5-second duration using the ML model instead of the more traditional approaches.

articleTitle: Routing Algorithm For WSN Based Idyllic Coverage in Sensor Networks with Efficient Area Coverage
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: To address the growing need for smart and connected devices in the Internet of Things (IoT), numerous routing algorithms have been developed to optimise communication in wireless sensor networks. In this paper, we describe a novel routing algorithm for IoT applications based on the energy-efficient clustering protocol (EECP). To improve network lifetime and minimise energy usage, the suggested method considers aspects such as energy consumption, network connection, and node mobility. We used real-world IoT data from a wireless sensor network to assess the performance of the suggested algorithm. We ran a series of simulations and statistical analyses to assess algorithm performance in terms of energy consumption, network lifetime, and network connectivity. Our findings show that the suggested routing method is effective for energy-efficient communication in wireless sensor networks for IoT applications. We also perform anomaly detection in the dataset to detect the anomalies.

articleTitle: Optimum Control With Minimum Battery Storage for Islanded Microgrid Operation Powered by Solar PV
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The application of islanded micro grid, powered by renewable energy sources such as solar PV is getting more vital due to the environmental crises of fossil fuel. Further to the greenhouse gas emission, the present economic crises pushes the utilities to look for alternative solutions to supply increasing customer demands. This challenge can be mitigated by using freely available solar power with the support of batteries. Presently batteries are expensive therefore an optimized solution is required. This paper proposed an optimized solution, which will be benefitted by the utility as well as the customer, based on their purchasing power. This scenario is analyzed with optimum control mechanism based on state of energy (SOE) of the battery. Hence the selection of minimum battery storage is the key component to achieve the cost effective solution. An optimized control concept is studied and the result show excellent outcome. For high-end potential energy consumers, who required reliable power supply, can also be accommodated using this optimized control concept. This released the stress on electricity suppliers as well as the consumers. The proposed optimized control open up new business strategy while categorizing confirmed reliable supply feeders. This will be the first step towards introducing reliable supply similar to the developed countries.

Author Keywords: optimized operation of islanded solar pv system

articleTitle: Edge Computing Based Secure Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The Smart Healthcare System developed based on edge computing is used in diagnosing the patient's disease when the doctor is far away from the patient. It facilitates remote monitoring treatment and stores the data in the edge server for quick retrieval. The sensors are used to determine patients condition and is aggregated by Internet of Things devices. The Liquid Crystal Display monitor displays the accurate results of patients. The details of patient and doctor registered are stored in edge server as well as in Strucured Query Language server. The Advanced Encryption Standard and Rivest - Shamir - Adlemen security mechanism is used for storing the data with security and privacy. The patient encrypts the data such as heart beat rate, blood pressure level, respiratory level, Electromyography level and sends to the doctor. The data's are stored in edge server. The doctor decrypt the data of patients and send the report to the patient for treatment. The data of patient's stored in edge server using Advanced Encryption Standard mechanism can be retrieved easily than Rivest - Shamir - Adlemen mechanism. Hight Encryption uses whitening Key Generation and sub key Generation for initial and final transformation.

articleTitle: Design of Conformal X-Band Bandpass FSS for SATCOM Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This article presents the design of a novel bandpass frequency selective surface for X-band communications. The proposed FSS operates in the frequency range of 8 – 10 GHz with a minimum insertion loss of −3 dB. The proposed FSS is constructed using a meandered spoke wheel structure enclosed in a square resonator. The unit cell FSS has a footprint of 5.5 × 5.5 mm. The proposed FSS is a single sided solution and offers good roll-off characteristics along the lower frequency edges. The FSS is developed using an ultra-thin polyimide substrate with a profile thickness of 0.05 mm making it an attractive solution for satellite communications looking for smaller payload characteristics. The proposed FSS exhibits both polarization and angular independence behavior in both Transverse Electric and Transverse Magnetic modes of operation. The bending analysis of the FSS proves that it is a most suitable one for satellite communications (SATCOM) with desirable bandpass characteristics.

articleTitle: Power Management of Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle Using Single Inductor Multi Input Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In fuel-cell electric vehicles, batteries compensate for the vehicle's poor power density, short response time, and limited ability to store energy. Two conventional converters will combine a fuel cell and batteries. One converter will serve as a unidirectional device, facilitating the connection between a fuel cell and a load. The second converter, on the other hand, will function as a bidirectional device, enabling the charging and discharging of a battery. This paper combines the two converters, removing the need for separate inductors and reducing the number of switches for each mode. Switches operating at lower voltages reduce voltage stress while increasing efficiency and power density. The proposed converter employs a fuzzy logic controller to transition between operating modes; this decreases the number of switches required, boosts the converter's power density, and mitigates the voltage stress it experiences.

articleTitle: Automatic Pill Dispenser
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The issue of medication misuse among senior patients is a significant concern. Forgetting to take medications on time is a common occurrence, increasing the risk of improper dosage. Additionally, there is a possibility of accidental ingestion of incorrect dosages, which can have serious consequences. Addressing these challenges is crucial to ensure the safe and effective administration of medications for senior patients. This project focuses on the design and implementation of an IoT-based Automatic Pill Dispenser, which aims to enhance medication by utilizing smart sensors and simplify pill administration. The system features a secure pill storage unit, a control module, and a user-friendly mobile application. Patients can personalize their medication schedules, receive reminders, and track their adherence through the mobile application. The integration of this innovative solution has the potential to revolutionize medication management practices and improve patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Cloud Based Optimization for Real-Time Voltage Stability Enhancement Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Voltage stability in a power system plays a crucial role to ensure reliable and uninterrupted operation. The voltage stability of the transmission line is influenced by line reactance, receiving-end reactive power and sending-end bus voltage. Voltage Stability Indices, which quantify these variables and provide a value to do quantitative analysis and decision on voltage stability. In this paper, suitable voltage stability enhancement actions are identified by solving an optimization problem where the cumulative voltage stability index of the grid is minimized using Genetic Algorithm. Initially, the proposed algorithm is tested on IEEE 5 Bus System with shunt, series, and shunt and series compensation with the objective to improve the voltage stability index. Later, to ensure the self-healing capability, the proposed optimization technique is implemented on the real-time IEEE 5 Bus Scaled down power system. The real-time information of the system is made available in the cloud using Internet of Things(IoT). The optimization based on Genetic Algorithm proposed is developed in the cloud. The decisions to enhance voltage stability through compensation by the algorithm are automatically incorporated into the system using cloud and edge based IoT technology. Edge is used to implement the compensation decision taken in cloud at various buses of the power system. The proposed architecture with optimization based decision is tested on a scaled down model of the IEEE 5-bus system. The results indicate that the proposed algorithm significantly enhances the voltage stability.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Gender Recognition Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Our study focuses on the development of a gender recognition system using fingerprint images. The study implemented a Convolutional Neural Network algorithm to extricate highlights from the unique mark pictures and allocate them as male or female. The dataset used for the study was preprocessed and augmented to elevate the model's performance. The training and testing accuracy measures are acclimated to evaluate the model's efficiency. The outcome exhibits that the CNN algorithm attains a training accuracy of 0.80 and a testing accuracy of 0.93. This study demonstrates the effectiveness of using CNN algorithms for gender recognition tasks using fingerprint images and provides a basis for further research in this field.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an Inexpensive Inertial Measurement Unit in the Arduino Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Integration of Micro Electro Mechanical Systems (MEMS)-based Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) for calculating roll, pitch, and yaw is presented in this paper. This paper presents the design of a low-cost IMU for calculating the attitude of an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle. In order to create a cheap inertial measurement unit that includes an accelerometer and gyroscope. Using the expanding microcontroller software environment, sensor integration with a 3-axis accelerometer and 3-axis gyroscope simulates 6 degrees of freedom orientation sensing. An inexpensive hardware implementation of many sensors is now possible thanks to the inclusion of computationally onboard microcontroller software like Arduino, which is used in a variety of aerospace applications.

articleTitle: Movie Recommendation Systems Using Improved Non-Negative Matrix Factorization
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Currently, there exist effective strategies for providing practical recommendations crucial in many industries, this encompasses a range of online platforms, such as electronic commerce, social networking sites, and various web-based services, as a result of the big data explosion. There are numerous customized movie recommendation systems available today that use publicly accessible movie datasets (like MovieLens) and provide enhanced performance measures (such the Root-Mean-Square Error (RMSE)). The ability to scale and the practicality of usage feedback and verification are determined through real-world implementation and assessment, they are two important difficulties that movie recommendation systems currently struggle with. This research suggests a novel approach using non-negative matrix factorization that resolves these issues through similarity and matrix factorization. Finding two matrices, both consisting of non-negative values, and their resulting product when multiplied together closely resembles the original matrix is the goal of non-negative matrix factorization. Additionally, it places the latent elements under non-negative constraints. The suggested approach offers novel update procedures to discover the latent variables for rating prediction. In contrast to the majority of collaborative filtering techniques, the suggested technique can forecast all the unknowable ratings. Its computational complexity is quite low, and it is simple to implement. Empirical research using the MovieLens shows that the suggested approach is more forgiving of the sparsity and scalability issues and produces good results.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Inrush Current On Star, Delta, and Star-Delta Starters for a 1,5kW Three Phase Induction Motor with Power Quality Analyzer and Powertag
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Implementing three-phase induction motors in the industrial sector is very diverse, such as an exhaust fan, a conveyor drive, Etc. A starter with a function as an initial control is needed to operate the motor. This research presents a condition of inrush current based on Direct On-Line (D.O.L) Star, Direct On-Line (D.O.L) Delta and the Star-Delta starter windings. The initial stage is creating a “Starter Simulator” module, which a 1.5 kW induction motor will later test. During that test, there will be an identification process using Power Quality Analyzer METREL related to the condition of the inrush current from every three starter windings, and its steady state current will be monitored by HMI-based PowerTag. The result shows that Star-Delta starter winding performs better than the Star and Delta starters.

articleTitle: Driving Aid Utilizing Android Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Now-a-Days, Transportation is the most important necessity for the people. So, the means of transport is increasing severely. In consequence, there is an extreme raise in road accidents. Automobile companies are hardly trying to overcome these issues and improved many Smart Conveyance Systems. Finding accidents and location of Vehicles with these in-built smart systems and sensors is easy. The detection of accident through the sensors is easy. But there are many drawbacks through this, like many vehicles cannot hold the hardware components and is high-priced to set up. In spite of these sensors, accident exposure can be done with the Internet of Things (IoT). The main aim of this system is to offer the driving assistance with low cost using the mobiles and its multifarious features. To assist the driver with respect to the simultaneous environment & surroundings an android application is developed.[1] To observe the surroundings LiDAR is used and, Accelerometer is used to check speed, noise and pressure values of the vehicle. Information attained by the LiDAR and Accelerometer is then analyzed to identify the possibility of accident. A caution message will be sent to the driver, rescue team, and family members through the navigation system.[4]

articleTitle: Single Switch DC-DC Boost Converter with MPPT Control for Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This article presents single switch boost dc–dc converter which addresses the issue of voltage mismatch that exists at the interface of fuel cell stack and the inverter's dc-link which requires higher constant voltage in fuel cell electric vehicles. It describes the steady state analyses of the single switch converter in different modes, as well as design considerations. In comparison to the other converters, this converter topology achieves a higher voltage gain for wide ranges of input voltage as well as reduced voltage stress on semiconductor switches. To demonstrate the Converter's performance, maximize output power and optimize power to a setpoint of fuel cell stack, a modified P&O-based MPPT control has been embedded and simulated with the aid of MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Heart disease is one of the destructive infections that an enormous populace of individuals all over the planet grieves. The prediction of heart disease is very much urged because of increasing death rates. The conventional method of prediction isn't adequate for such a disease. Evolving a clinical determination framework based on machine learning concepts gives more exact conclusions than the conventional way for the prediction of such illness. In this paper, we have used different machine learning algorithms to accurately foresee whether an individual has a heart illness or not. The concepts of machine learning like linear prediction KNN, SVM, and, ANN to predict the probability of heart disease in an individual are used. The medical and general details of the person like BMI, alcohol and tobacco consumption, etc. are used to make the prediction.

articleTitle: Smart Sericulture Monitoring System using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: We discuss the system of sericulture farming and the approaches that can improve the quality of the silk that can be produced and also can improve the efficiency of the production. The major parameters that impact the silkworm are temperature, humidity, and light. These are achieved with the help of a Microcontroller (Arduino) which is assisted by IoT, all the sensor data which is acquired from sensors from the field will update a simple cloud channel so the farmer can monitor from any location. The main objective of this is to acquire good quality silk with the least human intervention and an effective solution to the sericulture field while simultaneously being cost- effective.

articleTitle: Efficient Entry Management of Vehicles Through KNN-Based Character Recognition of Number Plates
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This study focuses on character recognition techniques for vehicle number plate recognition. It employs the K Nearest Neighbor (KNN) algorithm to detect the characters in the vehicle's number plate. In addition, it successfully identifies the state of origin of vehicles from the vehicle number thereby easing documentation of vehicles. Moreover, the algorithm marks the time of entry of vehicles in a systematic manner. The algorithm provides a methodological solution to keep track of the numerous vehicles entering a premise in an orderly fashion.

articleTitle: Dual Switch High Gain Multi-Level Capacitor Clamped Converter for Electric Transportation Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In the present article, a Dual switch high gain multi-level capacitor clamped converter is proposed for application in fuel cell-powered heavy electric transportation vehicles. The suggested topology reduces voltage stress on the power switches while delivering high voltage gain. This work solves the problems that high gain converters encounter, such as inrush currents and reverse recovery losses due to an increasing quantity of magnetized cores and diodes. To accommodate the fuel cell's flexible output characteristics, the suggested converter has an accessible wide input voltage. Finally, the viability of the suggested converter was tested using the proposed work in the MATLAB/SIMULINK tool with a power rating of 400 V/400 W.

articleTitle: ANN Based Single Phase Bidirectional DC-AC Boost Inverter for Grid Connected Solar Photovoltaic Systems without a Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The paper describes an artificial neural network (ANN)-based single-phase bidirectional DC-AC boost inverter for grid-connected solar PV systems without a transformer. The proposed inverter architecture effectively converts PV panel-generated DC power into AC power that can be injected into the grid. The typical boost inverter isolates the PV array from the grid with a large, costly transformer. The suggested technology is ideal for grid-connected PV systems since the inverter is smaller, cheaper, and simpler without a transformer. An ANN trained on simulated input-output data controls the bidirectional inverter. The ANN can accurately predict the grid voltage and frequency, as well as the duty cycle required for maximum power point tracking (MPPT). Using a realistic solar PV system model, comprehensive simulations were done to test the suggested inverter. Results show that the ANN-based control technique tracks the maximum power point well and stabilizes grid integration without a transformer. The suggested inverter has high efficiency, minimal THD, and quick grid disturbance response. Bidirectional power flow lets the PV system and grid exchange energy. The ANN-based single-phase bidirectional DC-AC boost inverter for grid-connected solar PV systems outperforms transformer-based inverters and costs less. The suggested design might help the grid embrace solar PV systems for clean, sustainable energy.

articleTitle: Multimodel Sensor Based Fog Prediction in Parkinson's Disease: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Freezing of Gaits (FOG) is a major and it is poorly understood symptom of Parkinson's disease (PD). 80% of advanced levels of PD patients experience the FOG. Freezing is patient's inability to move which is a temporary halt particularly in tight walking surroundings that causes motor disability or even fall. Detection of FOG is crucial without any proper examination. Real time EEG, ECG, EMG, acceleration (ACC) and skin conductance (SC) data are extracted from twelve PD patients. Extracted data are preprocessed. To enhance FOG prediction; here deep learning (DL) and signal processing technique is introduced. Multi stage spatial temporal based Conventional Neural Network- Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory (CNN-BiLSTM) algorithm is used for classification by training and testing data set. Attention mechanism is used in the LSTM blocks to select most relevant part of FOG in the data set. In the FOG prediction experimental result, the average accuracy achieved is 95.8%.

articleTitle: Spatial-Temporal Analysis for Traffic Incident Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The domain of Automatic Incident Detection(AID) on roads is predominantly focused on accident detection, lacking the ability to understand specific types of other incidents which may involve accidents. Moreover, existing methods often exhibit limited generalizability, making them susceptible to high error rates when faced with unknown scenarios. To handle these research gaps, this research proposes a deep learning approach that incorporates both the spatial and temporal aspect of videos for the purpose of multiclass video classification in traffic incident detection. By leveraging the modified LRCN network, we enable classification of videos into eight distinct road incident categories. We utilize the Highway incident detection dataset (HWID12) which has more than 2700 videos in different classes. Through rigorous training and comprehensive validation, our approach achieves a precision of 70.30% in the 8-class classification. When considering the dataset as a 2-class classification problem, we achieved an accuracy of 98.02%, which matches the benchmark accuracy on this dataset. These results demonstrate the efficacy of our CNN based framework for automated traffic incident detection, overcoming the limitations of existing methods in terms of specificity and generalizability.

articleTitle: Modelling of Hybrid Energy System for Demand-Side Management: A Case Study of Industrial Customer in Malaysia
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Efficiently managing energy demand is crucial for promoting sustainability in industrial sectors. This study introduces a MATLAB Simulink model that combines solar photovoltaic (PV), battery energy storage systems (BESS), and grid integration for effective industrial demand-side management. The main goals are to decrease peak demand and improve operational efficiency, addressing the challenges arising from high energy consumption and environmental concerns. The study also focuses on peak shaving and load shifting, achieved by using stored energy during high-demand periods and recharging during low-demand times. This leads to reduced load and balanced energy usage. However, the “Factory Load with Solar PV and Battery” configuration shows higher consumption due to battery charging. Nonetheless, a significant decrease in energy usage can be accomplished by increasing the solar PV system's capacity and prioritizing solar energy for battery charging. Future research should focus on enhancing hybrid energy strategies by integrating energy systems with demand response, particularly dynamic pricing. This integration holds great potential for initial cost reduction and improved returns on investment, guiding industries towards more sustainable practices.

articleTitle: A Non-Isolated Single-Input Multiple-Output DC-DC Converter for Auxiliary Power Loads in Electric Vehicle Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper comprises the analysis and design of a non-isolated Single-Input Multiple-Output (SIMO) DC-DC converter topology for an Auxiliary Power Module (APM) in an electric vehicle. The conventional multiple output DC-DC converters have restrictions on variations of duty ratio, output voltages, inductor currents, and cross-regulation issue that occurs during variation of load. This paper proposes a SIMO topology that overcomes the limitations mentioned earlier by producing separate outputs without impacting the functions of other loads by isolating them. The variation of load current in either of those outputs does not affect the output voltages in other output terminals. The proposed Single-Input Triple-Output (SITO) converter is a 100W prototype and designed to furnish three output voltages of 24V, 12V, and 5V to supply the onboard electric motor and other auxiliary loads of an electric vehicle.

articleTitle: Fractional-Order PID Control of Quadrotor Drone
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper explores quadrotors, unmanned aerial vehicles with four rotors that are most widely used as they are cost-effective and easily built due to their efficiency. The controller system used for these quadrotors is the proportional-integral-derivative (PID) plant model. However, the PID controller has certain limitations in achieving precise position control. To address these limitations, the performance of the PID controller is compared to that of a fractional-order PID (FOPID) controller through simulation. The FOPID controller is designed to fine-tune the PID plant model to improve drone stabilization and minimize disruptions during flight. After fine-tuning, the proposed FOPID controller achieved a lower settling time, better disturbance rejection, and better set point tracking than the PID controller. This performance improvement is also evident when dealing with complex inputs, such as sinusoidal signals.

articleTitle: Load Frequency Control of Renewable Sources Through Hybrid Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
