abstract: Ensuring the reliability of power systems is critical to meet dynamic load demands and prevent undesirable outcomes such as load shedding and blackouts resulting from uncontrolled frequency deviations. Load Frequency Control (LFC) plays a pivotal role in stabilizing power systems by minimizing frequency overshoots, undershoots, and settling time. This study explores the recent application of the Golden Eagle Optimization (GEO) technique to optimize the PID controller. Additionally, it investigates the injection of virtual inertia using a hybrid energy storage system comprising Super Magnetic Energy Storage System (SMES) and Redox Flow Battery (RFB). The integration of photovoltaic, wind, hydrogen aqua-electrolyzer, and biodiesel generator technologies is examined within a four-area power system. The results highlight that the GEO-optimized PID controller, in conjunction with SMES and RFB, effectively reduces settling time for frequency changes while mitigating frequency and tie-line deviations. This research contributes to enhancing power system reliability and its ability to handle fluctuations in load demands, thereby mitigating risks associated with uncontrolled frequency deviations.

articleTitle: Automated Wood Surface Defects Recognition System Using Yolov4-tiny Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Wood surface detection is a process of identifying and locating wooden surfaces in an image or video using computer vision techniques. This technique can be used in various applications such as furniture manufacturing, construction, and lumber mills. Wood defect detection is an important task in the wood industry as it ensures the quality of wood products. In this study, YOLOv4-tiny algorithm is proposed to detect seven types of wood defects from wood texture images. Analysis was performed by applying several detection models to detect the wood defects. The performance of the proposed model is evaluated in terms of precision, recall, F1-score, and mAP. The algorithm has the potential to improve the efficiency and quality of the wood industry and could be applied to other similar tasks, such as identifying defects in other materials and products.

articleTitle: Design of Wideband Flexible Transparent Patch Antenna for Sub-6 GHz Using Melinex
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Flexible transparent antennas are becoming a very promising future in the development of 5G technology. The requirement for reaching a compromise between the performance of the antenna and the flexibility makes designing of flexible antennas difficult. In this manuscript, a flexible transparent rectangular microstrip patch antenna using Melinex as substrate and AgHt-8 as the conductive material is proposed. At an operating frequency of 3.5GHz, the proposed antenna resonates in the sub-6 GHz range with the return loss greater then -10dB and achieves a broad bandwidth of above 100MHz in the desired frequency band. The proposed flexible transparent patch antenna is very much useful in applications such as IoT, mobile communications and in vehicle-to-vehicle communications.

articleTitle: Smart and Coordinated Charging Using Ensemble Model for Plug-in Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This work proposed smart and coordinated Plugin Electric Vehicle (PEV) charging technique, which incorporates the forecasting of electricity prices. This work aims to establish the most cost-effective charging schedule that satisfies both vehicle owners and network performance. This work presents the formulation of the PEV charging and discharging scheduling problem from the user's perspective aiming to minimize charging cost and satisfy the EV charging demand while considering the battery's state of charge (SOC), a narrow arrival time range, and electricity price forecasting (EPF). In this work, the control signal proposed using the ML method based on employing an ensemble classifier, which divides charging time hours into low and high charging zones. The proposed ensemble model showed significant improvement in prediction accuracy compared to other machine learning models namely Neural Networks (NN) and Naïve Bayes (NB).

articleTitle: Enhanced Grammar Error Detection and Correction Using Hybrid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Many applications rely on automatic spelling correction, such as web search engines, text summarization, sentiment analysis, and so on. The proposed Hybrid Algorithm uses Natural Language Processing to perform dictionary-based error detection and correction, analyzing the semantics of the text, detecting errors, and correcting them accordingly taking tense corrections, named entities and derivational forms into account. It is predicted to generate a faster and more precise grammar error detection and correction algorithm. Traditional models use non-word errors (words that cannot be found in the dictionary) as the basis of their identification and correction algorithm. Gradient descent algorithms are widely employed in Recurrent neural networks which frequently include an encoder-decoder structure where a portion of the model first converts the input text into a feature vector before decoding the vector to produce the output, which will be assisted by the BERT language model, which makes use of the context provided by the allowing computer to understand the idea by providing context to surrounding text, which allows easy understanding of ambiguous words.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Non-Isolated Multi-Input DC-DC Converter for Electric Vehicle Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)

authors.preferredName: Puteri Nor Aznie Fahsyar Binti Syed Mahadzir
authors.firstName: Puteri Nor Aznie Fahsyar Binti Syed

abstract: In this paper, a multi-input non-isolated DC-DC converter design for use in electric vehicle (EV) applications is described. The converter may simultaneously be connected to two separate power sources. The converter descriptions, various operation modes using equivalent circuits as well as in analytical waveforms are provided. Furthermore, the proposed converter will achieve high conversion ratios while yet exerting minimum stress on its capacitors and semiconductors. The artificial neural network (ANN)-based intelligent perturb and observe (P&O) algorithm drives the proposed MPPT technique, which aims to minimize oscillations at the maximum power point (MPP). The MPP's current and voltage values for solar irradiation and temperature are offered in advance by the ANN. The P&O calculates the optimum duty cycle for the proposed technique to accurately track the photovoltaic (PV) MPP based on the supplied current and voltage. The proposed converter experimental has been constructed and verified effectively in a laboratory environment.

articleTitle: Cognitively Robust Speech Diarization and Overlap Detection: An Advanced Model for Granular Analysis of Audio Segments
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Multiple speakers conversing at once, or overlapping speech, poses a significant challenge in various speech analysis applications. The accuracy of handling this phenomenon greatly affects tasks such as speaker identification and speech recognition. Current methodologies categorize overlapping speech using individual techniques like MFCC (Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients), LFCC (Linear Frequency Cepstral Coefficients), and STFT (Short-time Fourier Transform), yielding certain results. In this research, we propose a comparative study that refines features using MFCC, LFCC, STFT, and wavelet transform, combined with a CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) model for classification. By capturing both time and frequency data, the Wavelet Transform holds promise for improving the precision of overlapping speech classification. To capture complex patterns and variations, the CNN model develops hierarchical representations. Our findings indicate that implementing MFCC in the CNN model yields superior results compared to LFCC. Additionally, the Wavelet transform outperforms the STFT transform in terms of performance and effectiveness. Furthermore, this paper places emphasis on the implementation of an algorithm that focuses on voice diarization and overlap detection. The objective is to accurately detect and categorize overlapping voice segments within an audio file, enabling a better understanding of its structure. The algorithm estimates the overall duration of each group by combining consecutive chunks with the same categorization, providing valuable insights into the temporal distribution of overlapping speech. Leveraging this data, the algorithm predicts the starting and ending periods of overlapping voice segments, facilitating the localization of overlaps.

articleTitle: Significance of Secure Internet of Things Device Certification – An Authentication Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) devices are connected network smart elements, sensors, and software capabilities that allow for data acquisition and transact via the internet. These days, it's very difficult to secure the devices used in the IoT applications. This article talks about concise review of the security challenges in IoT devices, kinds of attacks, IoT security software tools and available directives for IoT system design. The main contribution is the change in emphasis from architecture to devices and the suggestion of technology advancements needed for IoT device security. This investigation also studies about standards and certifying procedures currently in vogue and suggests a route for further research. It also discusses the current testing techniques and technological advancements that will affect device certification in the future.

articleTitle: Exploring Trends in Global Temperature: A Data Analysis Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: As the global concern over climate change intensifies, understanding trends in global temperature becomes paramount for informed decision-making and policy formulation. This research paper employs a data-driven approach to analyze historical temperature records and uncover patterns contributing to our comprehension of climate change dynamics. Using data from reputable sources such as the NOAA - National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration and the NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration, we conduct comprehensive data preprocessing, descriptive analysis, seasonal and regional variation assessments, linear regression modeling, and correlation analyses. In this study, we use data science methods to analyze temperature trends and their links to other climate variables. Our findings, presented through clear data visualizations, emphasize the importance of continuous monitoring and show how data analysis can enhance climate change awareness and guide adaptation strategies.

articleTitle: A Brief Survey on Efficient Models for Qubits Encoding Using Quantum Machine Learning With Multi Level Time Series Data Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: When it comes to realizing immediate quantum advantages in practical applications like machine learning and optimization techniques, numerous methods have emerged as a frontrunner technique. Such algorithms often involve quantum circuits for data encoding and the training of Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs) to minimize target functions when applied to tasks involving classical data. Quantum Machine Learning (QML) is a promising area of quantum computing because it may effectively handle difficult learning tasks by taking advantage of the high dimensional Hilbert space to train better representations from limited data. Despite QML's rising popularity, few academic works have addressed the language's security features. There has been a lot of buzz about the promising new discipline of quantum machine learning. Training a parameterized quantum circuit is a common practice in contemporary QML for performing data analysis on classical or quantum datasets. To make accurate predictions on an independent test dataset, state-of-the-art QML techniques first variationally optimize a parameterized quantum circuit using the training dataset. Quantum modeling in QML has also been shown to offer an exponential benefit in sample complexity. In the realms of pattern recognition, machine learning, and data mining, feature dimensionality reduction as a crucial link in the process has become one hot and tough spot. Most academics have gravitated towards this topic because of the difficulty of its studies. The goal of this research is to learn how to implement low loss in the procedure of feature dimension reduction, preserve the integrity of the original data, locate the most effective mapping, and obtain the best possible low-dimensional data. Preliminary findings suggest that QML models may offer advantages over classical models for classical data analysis. In this paper, a thorough investigation into generalization performance in QML is performed. This paper presents a brief survey on Qubits Encoding using Quantum Machine Learning models that help researchers to identify the limitations of the existing models and to design new efficient models for better performance levels.

articleTitle: Analysis of Welding Power Source Using a Double Star Rectifier with Interface Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Heat is produced as a result of high-velocity atomic collisions, which occur more frequently as more charge passes across a circuit. In the welding process, a high current regulated rectifier is crucial. To accommodate the high current needs, many converters are connected in parallel. There will be no circulating current when these converters are linked in parallel with Inter Phase Transformer (IPT), and the ripple voltages and average output voltage of the converters will be the same. The welding power supply is modeled here using a double star rectifier with IPT. The Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) tool in the MATLAB software is used to test the welding power supply under all harmonics analysis situations. Based on the THD value of the welding power supply, all test circumstances are assessed. All of the findings must meet IEEE Standard 519. The THD will be 27.51%, according to the research. Small changes in frequency have a large impact on THD under diverse frequency settings (27.51% to 57.39%). Conditions such as voltage tolerance, voltage pre-distortion, short circuit ratio, and voltage imbalance have little effect on the system.

articleTitle: Review of Detection and Classification of Power Quality Disturbances Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Power quality disturbances (PQDs) present major challenges to the stable operation of electricity systems. Traditional methods for detecting and classifying PQDs rely on manual analysis and predefined rules, which can be time-consuming, subjective, and unable to manage complex patterns. Researchers have investigated the application of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) techniques to the field of power quality (PQ) analysis in the context of their development. This article provides a summary of recent advances in the detection and classification of PQDs using ML and DL methods. Various algorithms and architectures, such as Support vector machines (SVM), neural networks (NN), convolutional neural networks (CNN), etc., are discussed. The paper explores a review of the detection and classification of PQDs Using ML and DL Methods. In addition, challenges and future directions in the field are presented to direct future research in this important domain. This review demonstrates the potential for machine learning and deep learning to improve the detection and classification of PQDs, resulting in more effective power quality management and enhanced system reliability.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of a Modifed Three-Phase Multilevel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Inverters are crucial for various applications, including electricity systems, residential settings, the automobile industry, and manufacturing. The Multilevel Inverter (MLI) has gained popularity due to its ability to produce waveform outputs resembling sinusoidal waveforms with minimal harmonics. However, the MLI's high component count presents a significant challenge and drawback. To address this issue and make the manufacturing process more efficient and cost-effective, the paper proposes a modified topology that reduces the number of switches in the MLI architecture. The suggested modification is evaluated using simulations in the SIMULINK environment, considering parameters such as Total Harmonic Distortion (%THD), power loss, inverter cost, and size. Comparing the results of the simulations reveals several benefits of the modified topology, including a more compact design and improved cost-effectiveness.

articleTitle: Design of Maneuverable Robotic Arm in Pharmaceutical Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The pharmaceutical industry continuously seeks to improve production processes to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and safety. Robotic arms have emerged as a versatile solution for automating various tasks, including handling delicate pharmaceutical components. This research paper presents the design and control of a manually operated, 2 DOF maneuverable robotic arm specifically tailored for pharmaceutical industry applications. The proposed robotic arm leverages a combination of DPDT switches, servo motors, and an Arduino microcontroller for precise control. The DPDT switches enable intuitive manual control over the robot's movements, allowing an operator to easily manipulate the arm's joints and end effector. The servo motors provide the required actuation to achieve the desired motion of the arm. To ensure smooth and accurate operation, the control system is implemented using an Arduino microcontroller. The microcontroller facilitates the synchronization of the DPDT switches and servo motors, enabling seamless coordination between the operator's input and the arm's response. This real-time control mechanism enhances the overall dexterity and maneuverability of the robotic arm, making it suitable for intricate tasks encountered in the pharmaceutical industry.

articleTitle: Ocean Wave Height Forecasting using Deep Learning Neural Networks and Optimization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Ocean wave prediction is crucial for many marine applications, including navigation and coastal engineering. Accurate wave height prediction can help reduce the risks. In this paper, we have implemented an interface that can predict wave height based on Neural Network, Optimization models and compared the performances of these models on the Mooloolaba Beach Dataset with regular and irregular waves. The models we experimented with are single-shot LSTM, multi-shot LSTM, CNN-LSTM Hybrid model, Bidirectional LSTM, Artificial Neural Networks(ANN) with different kernels like Laplacian, Polynomial, ANOVA Radial basis, and Multi Additive Regression Trees(MART). These models are designed to capture the Nonlinear and Temporal characteristics of ocean waves. We have also experimented with different optimization techniques like Symbiotic Organisms Search (SOS), Hybrid Symbiotic Organisms Search (HSOS), and Moth Flame Optimization (MFO). The Dataset covers a period of One year and has a sampling Frequency of 1.28Hz. We evaluate the models using six metrics: Accuracy, Precision, F1 score, Mean Square Error, Mean Absolute Error, and Root mean square error. The results show that the ANN model with ANOVA kernel outperformed other models in terms of Accuracy of 94.5%. We have also developed a Web Interface. It helps Fishermen to make informed decisions, reduce the risks associated with uncertain wave conditions, and contribute to a safer fishing experience.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Dual Axis Tracking System for Improving Efficiency of the PV Panel
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Power demand has been increasing drastically at an alarming rate around the globe. Continuous search in finding a sustainable source paved the way for utilizing renewable resources in the power generation sector. Especially, the contribution of solar photovoltaics in supporting the residential and remote locations is massive. However, the output of solar modules could be reduced to a significant extent if it is not fully exposed to sunlight. This paper proposes a Dual Axis Tracking System to maximize the output of the PC arrays by positioning them at an optimized angle; so that the panels receive maximum irradiance around the clock. This feasibility study of employing Dual Axis Tracking Systems is composed of 2 stages; the first stage synergically adjusts the panels angle up to 1200 east-to-west by utilizing a light dependent sensor (LDR) and the utilization of a PIC 16F877 microcontroller embedded with and Stepper motors to align the angle of the PV array for the maximum output. The tracking system involves a better Sun position algorithm to calculate the solar zenith and azimuth angles. The second objective includes minimizing the amount of power required to operate the system, which involves choosing an appropriate low-power motors and efficient programs for the controller.

Author Keywords: Sun Position Algorithm and Light Dependent Sensor

articleTitle: Optimal Integration of Large-Scale Solar and Battery Energy Storage System in Malaysia
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The paper presents a comprehensive study on the optimal development and integration of a Large Scale Solar Photovoltaic (LSS PV) system with Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) in Malaysia. The research focuses on three main objectives to ensure efficient and cost-effective solar power generation and grid integration. Different types of solar PV panels; monocrystalline, polycrystalline, and thin film have been analyzed for their technical performance and economic impact. A 50 MW LSS PV system is simulated in Kampung Kuala Kuli in Kedah due to its favorable Global Horizontal Irradiance (GHI) index. Then, a seamless integration of the LSS PV system into the grid, considering system constraints and optimal operation has been performed considering load flows during normal and contingency analysis, total power loss, QV, and reactive power capability to ensure the grid's stable and reliable performance following LSS PV system integration. Finally, the paper studies various battery technologies to determine their economic impact when integrated with the LSS PV system. The cost of energy (COE) is analyzed for different types and sizes of BESS to identify the most cost-effective solution, facilitating the efficient storage and utilization of surplus solar energy. The findings from this study will provide valuable insights for policymakers, energy planners, and investors looking to deploy large-scale solar PV systems with battery storage in Malaysia. The research outcomes contribute to the advancement of sustainable energy integration and help in accelerating the adoption of renewable energy sources for a greener and more resilient power grid.

articleTitle: Tagging Speech For Words In Low Resourced Monolingual Contexts of Sanskrit Shlokas
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Natural Language Processing is widely used in Machine translation which helps in replacing many tedious and difficult tasks and producing qualitative and efficient results. Sanskrit is one of the primitive languages of India. It is also the oldest, purest and most systematic language in the world. It is a magical language which helps in generating different words from a single word by prefixing and suffixing the word with different helper words to same root word. Shloka in Sanskrit are phrases or words that represent a poem or a hymn. The famous texts written entirely in shlokas are the “Ramayana” and “Mahabharata.” This paper aims to generate the POS tags for each word in Sanskrit Shlokas using various machine learning and deep learning algorithms thus helping in understanding the actual verbal beauty of Sanskrit Shlokas in widely spoken language English. The proposed work implements Parts of Speech Tagging for words in Sanskrit Shlokas using Conditional Random Field, Gaussian NB and Bi-directional LSTM models. Of the implemented approaches, Bi-directional LSTM gives the best result.

articleTitle: Analysis of Image Restoration Techniques on Lunar Surface Images
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Lunar surface images captured by Chandrayaan-II, leveraging advanced image restoration techniques. The images obtained from the space craft can subject to various noise influence depending on the data acquisition system. Our goal is to investigate the effect of various types of noise in the image, such as Gaussian, Salt and Pepper, and Speckle noise, necessitating advanced restoration approaches for optimal data extraction. Our primary objective is to employ three restoration techniques such as Wiener, Median and Gaussian filters to restore the lunar images. Through the implementation of these restoration techniques, we aim to mitigate the adverse effect of sensor noise, thermal noise, cosmic ray noise, transmission noise and compression artifacts, all of which impede the precise interpretation of lunar surface features. These restoration methods are then compared in various noise levels and has been evaluated in terms of SNR, PSNR, image fidelity and MSE. The outcomes are encouraging and the suggested technique provides more precise restoration for images of the lunar surface.

articleTitle: Electric Power Generation-A New Scenario Using Biodiesel
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Energy is a dynamic factor in commercial aspects of any country and one of the basic factors that describe the quality of life. Country's energy security would remain susceptible until alternate fuels to substitute/supplement petroleum based fuels are developed based on indigenously produced renewable feedstocks. The most important objective of the paper is to use biodiesel as a resolution for the existing energy crisis and to evaluate the enactment of the diesel power generator which was biodiesel fueled. Biofuels are environment friendly fuels and their utilization would report global anxieties about devastation of carbon emissions. The biodiesel defined in this paper was produced by the simplest process called transesterification with neem oil as a source. The transesterification was processed with methanol as solvent and potassium hydroxide as catalyst. The properties of biodiesel are similar to that of petroleum diesel. The performance of the diesel generator is articulated using the characteristic graphs. The characteristics of the generator in terms of voltage, frequency, and power for different speeds are revealed. It's noticeable that carbon and sulphur emissions are reduced.

articleTitle: Static Image Analysis of Two Dimensional Projection of Particles
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Particle visualization and analysis using static image analysis has emerged as a valuable technique in the study of particle behaviour and characteristics in a two-dimensional environment. The significance of this analysis unveils essential insights into particle size, shape, and overarching characteristics. This paper presents a comprehensive methodology for particle analysis using image processing, based on a combination of previously advocated methods and papers which have been referenced to help the reader further understand the concept of static image analysis of particles. Advanced imaging equipment is employed for data acquisition, followed by preprocessing techniques. The watershed segmentation algorithm is applied to precisely separate individual particles, even in complex cases. Geometric properties are computed, enabling insights into particle size, shape, and characteristics. Statistical analysis allows for comparisons across datasets, facilitating better understanding and anomaly detection. This methodology serves as a powerful tool for particle analysis in nanotechnology, fluid dynamics, and biomedical research, leading to advancements in various applications.

articleTitle: A Privacy Protection Mechanism for Indian Health Care Data Exchange Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Currently, India is marching towards complete e-Governance. In healthcare, the NHA (National Health Authority) initiated the ABDM (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission) to assist the country's integrated digital health infrastructure. This mission's main focus is on creating a national digital health ecosystem. The main aim of this ecosystem is to facilitate a trustworthy, easy-to-share environment for storing health records. To speed up the national digital health ecosystem's development, the NHA is looking forward to creating innovative solutions and inviting interested parties to participate in the development. Data security and privacy play a vital role in this situation. With its distributed, immutable ledger property, blockchain offers a promising result. Many countries are trying to adopt blockchain for their health applications, like patient data storage, maintaining drug supply chains, and insurance claims. In this paper, we identified some solutions using blockchain platforms and their usage and benefits to establish a secure, transparent, and trustworthy environment in India.

articleTitle: Security Analysis of OAuth 2.0 Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Many users all over the world routinely use open authentication and authorization providers based on OAuth 2.0 framework such as Google, Facebook etc. to sign in to third-party websites (relying party). The authentication (OpenID connect) and authorization (OAuth) protocol based on OAuth 2.0 framework enables the relying party application to authenticate its users and gain access to their protected resources without storing any of the sensitive user credentials such as usernames and passwords. Hence, the implementation of these protocols by the relying parties and identity providers play an important role in security of the user information and their privacy. The risk of attacks on improper implementation of these protocols can cause unauthorized access to the user accounts. In this work, we focused on testing the OAuth implementations done by the relying parties. For the secure implementation of OAuth 2.0 we found that following parameters must be present while generating OAuth request: client_id, state, response_type, redirect_uri and scope. We have analyzed our work with around 75 websites that were using Google as an identity provider to provide access to its users. Out of 75 relying parties, 30% were found vulnerable to CSRF attack due to missing state parameter, 13% used implicit flow which reveals id_token or access_token in the OAuth URL and 2% had secret parameters in OAuth URL. We developed a browser extension which successfully identify and alert its user on these issues.

articleTitle: Explainable AI for Medical Imaging: Advancing Transparency and Trust in Diagnostic Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2023 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is an existing degenerative joint disease with a potential societal impact, requiring accurate and early diagnosis for effective treatment. In this work, we have deployed deep learning techniques, specifically ResNet50 and VGG16, to predict osteoarthritis from medical imaging data. Remarkably, our models produced an impressive accuracies of 91.0% and 89.5% respectively, showing the efficacy of CNN in OA classification. To further better the interpretability in the predictions of our model ,we used GradCam++ visualization, a technique that enabled us in generating heat maps that highlights the regions crucial for model decision-making. Optimizing GradCam++, we noticed an improvement in accuracy to 93.0%, reinforcing its value in refining model interpretability. The generated heat maps are used not only in understanding the model validation but also in providing clinicians with useful information regarding the areas of concern within the medical images. Our outcomes shows the ability of combining deep learning techniques with visualization tools like GradCam++ to enhance predictive accuracy and to offer trustable and interpretable results. The areas of concern in the heat maps throw light on the specific features influencing the model's decision. This combined method promises for advancing the field of medical image analysis, fostering more accurate and clinically applicable diagnostic tools for osteoarthritis and potentially other medical conditions.
